explanation: El caso de uso principal de los retrievers es extraer datos relevantes de una base vectorial para enriquecer un prompt en la arquitectura RAG.

question: Universal Containers has grounded a prompt template with a related list. During user acceptance testing (UAT), users are not getting the correct responses. What is the most likely cause?
options: The related list is not configured in Data Cloud.
The related list is not on the parent object's page layout.
The related list merge field is not supported in this type of prompt template.
explanation: Para que las listas relacionadas funcionen en un prompt template, deben estar visibles en el diseño de página (page layout) del objeto principal.

question: Universal Containers plans to enhance its sales team's productivity using AI. Which specific use case is best suited for Prompt Builder?
options: Creating a draft newsletter for an upcoming tradeshow.
Automatically syncing leads from an external CRM.
Generating real-time dashboards from Salesforce reports.
explanation: Prompt Builder es perfecto para generar borradores de newsletters usando datos del CRM y un LLM para crear contenido de texto personalizado.

question: In a Knowledge-based data library configuration, what is the primary difference between the identifying fields and the content fields?
options: Identifying fields are mandatory, while content fields are optional.
Identifying fields store metadata, while content fields store the full article text.
Identifying fields help locate the correct Knowledge article, while content fields enrich AI responses with detailed information.
explanation: Los campos identificadores localizan el artículo correcto, mientras que los campos de contenido enriquecen la respuesta de la IA.

question: An Agentforce Specialist needs to create a prompt template to fill a custom field named Latest Opportunities Summary on the Account object with information from the three most recently opened opportunities. How should the Agentforce Specialist gather the necessary data for the prompt template?
options: Select the Account Opportunity object as a resource when creating the prompt template.
Create a flow to retrieve the opportunity information.
Use formula fields to reference the Einstein related list of opportunities.
explanation: Para obtener datos granulares y ordenados, se debe usar un flujo activado por plantilla (template-triggered prompt flow) en lugar de listas relacionadas.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to implement a solution in Salesforce with a custom UX that allows users to enter a sales order number. Subsequently, the system will invoke a custom prompt template to create and display a summary of the sales order header and sales order details. Which approach should UC use?
options: Create a Lightning Web Component that calls the prompt template via Apex.
Create a screen flow to collect the sales order number and invoke the prompt template using the standard Prompt Template flow action.
Use an Autolaunched Flow triggered by a record update to invoke the prompt template.
explanation: Un Screen Flow permite recoger el número de orden e invocar el prompt template, ofreciendo una experiencia de usuario sin necesidad de código Apex.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is creating a new custom prompt template to populate a field with generated output. UC enabled the Einstein Trust Layer to ensure AI Audit data is captured and monitored for adoption and possible enhancements. Which prompt template type should UC use, and what additional configuration is required?
options: Sales Email, and that the object is associated with a campaign.
Field Generation, and that Dynamic Forms is enabled.
Record Summary, and that the Lightning page is updated to Dynamic Forms.
explanation: Para rellenar campos con salidas de IA, se debe usar el tipo de plantilla Field Generation y habilitar Dynamic Forms en la página.

question: Universal Containers (UC) plans to implement prompt templates that utilize the standard foundation models. Which technique should UC use to get more contextual and relevant responses from the LLM?
options: Ask it to role-play as a character in the prompt template to provide more context to the LLM.
Increase the max tokens parameter to allow longer responses.
Use only keyword-based grounding to ensure deterministic outputs.
explanation: Pedirle al LLM que asuma un rol específico (role-play) proporciona más contexto y genera respuestas más relevantes como técnica de prompt engineering.

question: Universal Containers (UC) plans to answer questions based on similar cases that have been successfully resolved in the past. What should UC consider when implementing this approach?
options: No action is needed, as past cases are used to answer the question.
Create a data model object (DMO) based on Case object and create an index on it.
Create an unstructured data model object (UDMO) based on Case object and create an index on it.
explanation: Como Case es un objeto estructurado (DMO) estándar en Data Cloud, se debe crear un índice de búsqueda directamente en sus campos de texto.

question: When a verified customer in a help center says, “I want to upgrade my service plan,” an AI agent needs to complete the following tasks: Verify identity and entitlement. Create a new quote. Calculate a prorated upgrade amount. Escalate to an Account Executive (AE) only if the reorder exceeds USD 25,000. Which type of agent should an AgentForce Specialist build to support this use case?
options: Service Agent to resolve the case end-to-end and create a new opportunity for the sales team
Sales Agent to handle the upsell and large-deal escalation
Employee Agent to orchestrate internal logistics and finance
explanation: El Sales Agent está diseñado específicamente para gestionar cotizaciones, ventas adicionales y escalamientos por montos elevados en flujos comerciales.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts (CCR) sees the agent forgot the dietary/activity preferences gathered earlier. They need those preferences to persist throughout the session. What should CCR implement?
options: Configure custom variables to capture/store customer preferences from action outputs.
Rely on natural conversation memory and instruct the agent to look back.
Create a context variable to capture/store customer preferences as action outputs.
explanation: Las variables personalizadas (custom variables) permiten capturar y almacenar preferencias del usuario a lo largo de la sesión para que el agente acceda a ellas.

question: In addition to Recipient and Sender, which object should an Agentforce utilize for inserting merge fields into a Sales email template prompt?
options: Recipient Opportunities
Recipient Account
User Organization
explanation: Recipient Account permite incluir datos de oportunidades relacionadas al destinatario dentro de un prompt de Sales Email para personalizar el correo.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has configured a data library and wants to restrict indexing of knowledge articles to articles which are only publicly available in their knowledge base. UC also wants the agent to link sources that the large language model (LLM) grounded its response on. Which settings should help UC with this?
options: In the data library setting window, under Knowledge Settings, enable Use Public Knowledge Article and select Show sources.
In the data library setting window, under Knowledge Settings, enable Use Public Knowledge Article. It is not possible to display articles that the LLM grounded its response in.
Use Data Categories to categorize publicly available articles to index. Sources are automatically displayed when knowledge articles are categorized as Public.
explanation: Habilitar 'Use Public Knowledge Article' restringe la indexación a artículos públicos, mientras que 'Show sources' muestra las fuentes usadas por el LLM.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts wants visibility into credit usage associated with testing. Which feature supports this?
options: Agentforce Analytics
Digital Wallet
Testing Center
explanation: Digital Wallet es la herramienta que proporciona visibilidad sobre el consumo de créditos de Agentforce y Einstein en pruebas y operaciones.

question: What is an appropriate use case for leveraging Agentforce Sales Agent in a sales context?
options: Enable a sales team to use natural language to invoke defined sales tasks grounded in relevant data and be able to ensure company policies are applied conversationally and in the flow of work.
Enable a sales team by providing them with an interactive step-by-step guide based on business rules to ensure accurate data entry into Salesforce and help close deals faster.
Instantly review and read incoming messages or emails that are then logged to the correct opportunity, contact, and account records to provide a full view of customer interactions.
explanation: Agentforce Sales Agent permite a los equipos ejecutar tareas usando lenguaje natural, asegurando que las políticas se apliquen conversacionalmente en el flujo de trabajo.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is tracking web activities in Data Cloud for a unified contact, and wants to use that in a prompt template to help extract insights from the data. Assuming that the Contact object is one of the objects associated with the prompt template, what is a valid way for UC to do this?
options: Call the prompt directly from Data Cloud with a web tracing activity included in the prompt definition.
Add the activity records as an enrichment related list to the Contact then pass the Contact into a prompt template workspace using related list grounding.
Create a prompt template that takes a list of all Data Cloud activity records as input to pass to the large language model (LLM).
explanation: La mejor manera de incluir actividad web es agregar esos registros como una lista relacionada al Contacto en Data Cloud para usarla en el prompt.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is looking to improve its sales team's productivity by providing real-time insights and recommendations during customer interactions. Why should UC consider using Agentforce Sales Agent?
options: To track customer interactions for future analysis
To automate the entire sales process for maximum efficiency
To streamline the sales process and increase conversion rates
explanation: Agentforce Sales Agent agiliza el proceso de ventas al proveer insights en tiempo real para aumentar las tasas de conversión durante las interacciones.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to use Generative AI Salesforce functionality to reduce Service Agent handling time by providing recommended replies based on the existing Knowledge articles. On which AI capability should UC train the service agents?
options: Service Replies
Case Replies
Knowledge Replies
explanation: Knowledge Replies genera respuestas recomendadas basándose en artículos de Knowledge existentes para reducir significativamente el tiempo de manejo.

question: Universal Containers (UC) needs to create a custom prompt template that can be called from a Lightning web component. Which prompt template type should UC create?
options: Field Generation
Sales Email
Flex
explanation: Flex es el único tipo de plantilla que puede invocarse desde un Lightning Web Component vía API. Los demás tipos están ligados a contextos de interfaz específicos.

question: Where should the Agentforce Specialist go to add/update actions assigned to an Agent?
options: Agent Actions page, the record page for the Agent Action, or the Agent Action Library tab
Agent Actions page or Global Actions
Agentforce Detail page, Global Actions, or the record page for the Agent Action
explanation: Para gestionar acciones de un agente, se puede usar la página Agent Actions, la página de registro de la acción o la pestaña Agent Action Library.

question: After creating a foundation model in Einstein Studio, which hyperparameter should an Agentforce Specialist use to adjust the balance between consistency and randomness of a response?
options: Presence Penalty
Variability
Temperature
explanation: El parámetro Temperature controla el balance entre consistencia y aleatoriedad en las respuestas. Valores bajos generan resultados más deterministas, mientras que valores altos fomentan la creatividad.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has registered an external service and created a template-triggered prompt flow that invokes the external service to fetch data from a REST API. UC now needs to make the response data from the external service usable inside a prompt template as a merge field when the template runs. How should UC meet this requirement?
options: Use External Service Record merge fields.
Convert the JSON to an XML merge field.
Use the 'Add Prompt Instructions' flow element.
explanation: Los datos recuperados vía REST API se almacenan como registros de servicios externos. Se pueden referenciar dinámicamente en las plantillas usando campos de combinación de estos registros.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is discussing its AI strategy in an agile Scrum meeting. Which business requirement would lead an Agentforce Specialist to recommend connecting to an external foundational model via Einstein Studio (Model Builder)?
options: UC wants to fine-tune model temperature.
UC wants a model fine-tuned using company data.
UC wants to change the frequency penalty of the model.
explanation: Usar Model Builder para un modelo externo es ideal cuando se requiere un modelo ajustado con datos propios de la empresa. Otros ajustes menores se pueden realizar en Model Playground.

question: Which part of the Einstein Trust Layer architecture leverages an organization's own data within a large language model (LLM) prompt to confidently return relevant and accurate responses?
options: Prompt Defense
Data Masking
Dynamic Grounding
explanation: Dynamic Grounding enriquece el prompt del LLM con datos propios de la organización para generar respuestas precisas. Otras capas de seguridad no aportan contexto del CRM.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts is about to start testing its concierge agent with guests. Which metrics should be captured to monitor the performance, correctness, and user experience?
options: Agent performance, token usage, and conversation duration
Response performance, tone, and CSATs
Response times, accuracy and relevance of answers, and resolution success
explanation: Para evaluar el agente, se deben medir los tiempos de respuesta, la precisión de las contestaciones y el éxito en la resolución. Estas métricas cubren el rendimiento, la exactitud y la experiencia de usuario.

question: Which configuration must an Agentforce Specialist complete for users to access generative AI-enabled fields in the Salesforce mobile app?
options: Enable Mobile Generative AI.
Enable Mobile Prompt Responses.
Enable Dynamic Forms on Mobile.
explanation: Es necesario habilitar Dynamic Forms on Mobile para acceder a campos generados por IA en la app móvil. Sin esto, el icono de generación no estará visible.

question: What is the purpose of applying filters in a custom retriever configuration?
options: Filters narrow the search results by applying up to 10 conditions based on fields defined in the search index, thereby enhancing the relevancy of the content returned.
Filters automatically encrypt and mask sensitive fields in the search index to ensure that only non-confidential information is retrieved for public queries.
Filters reformat and aggregate multiple documents into a single summary output to streamline and unify retriever output for more efficient and accurate AI grounding.
explanation: Los filtros en un retriever personalizado acotan la búsqueda usando hasta 10 condiciones del índice, mejorando la relevancia de los resultados. Su propósito exclusivo es delimitar el alcance del contenido retornado.

question: Sales reps at Universal Containers should not be able to create or edit prompt templates. Which permission set should an Agentforce Specialist assign to the sales reps?
options: Prompt Execute User
Prompt Template Manager
Prompt Template User
explanation: El conjunto de permisos Prompt Template User permite solo ejecutar plantillas existentes, sin poder crearlas o editarlas. Es ideal para usuarios finales que no requieren gestionar los prompts.

question: How does Secure Data Retrieval ensure that only authorized users can access necessary Salesforce data for dynamic grounding?
options: Retrieves Salesforce data based on the 'Run As' user's permissions.
Retrieves Salesforce data based on the user's permissions executing the prompt.
Retrieves Salesforce data based on the Prompt template's object permissions.
explanation: Secure Data Retrieval obtiene datos según los permisos del usuario que ejecuta el prompt. Así se asegura que solo acceda a la información permitida por su perfil y configuración de seguridad.

question: Universal Containers wants to keep retrieval accurate as product documentation changes frequently. Which approach should the company implement?
options: Leave embedding unchanged even if content is updated.
Rebuild the search index.
Manually delete the stale data chunks.
explanation: Reconstruir el índice de búsqueda es clave cuando la documentación cambia con frecuencia. Esto regenera los embeddings y asegura resultados basados en la información más actual.

question: An Agentforce Specialist created a Field Generation prompt template. What should the Agentforce Specialist do to expose the template to the user?
options: Use a screen flow to associate the Field Generation prompt template.
Associate the template with the form field on the Lightning page.
Call a template using an autolaunched flow.
explanation: Para que el usuario vea un Field Generation prompt template, debe asociarse al campo en la Lightning page. Esto mostrará el icono correspondiente para generar contenido directamente.

question: What is the primary function of the planner service in the Agent system?
options: Generating record queries based on conversation history
Offering real-time language translation during conversations
Identifying Agent Actions to respond to user utterances
explanation: El planner service identifica las acciones más adecuadas del agente para responder al usuario. Evalúa la solicitud, elige el tema correcto y define el orden de ejecución.

question: What is a Salesforce Agentforce Specialist able to configure in Data Masking within the Einstein Trust Layer?
options: The profiles exempt from masking
The encryption keys for masking
The privacy data entities to be masked
explanation: Data Masking permite configurar qué entidades de datos privados (como correos o teléfonos) se deben ocultar. En esta sección no se gestionan claves de cifrado ni perfiles exentos.

question: Cloud Kicks (CK) is launching a new partner portal on Experience Cloud. CK wants to provide partners with an agent that can answer questions about product specifications from the knowledge base and allow them to submit a new Lead for a potential customer they've identified. The agent must be accessible only to authenticated partner users on the portal. Which agent type is required to meet this scenario?
options: Sales Agent
Commerce Agent
Service Agent
explanation: Service Agent es el agente adecuado para responder consultas de Knowledge y gestionar Leads en un portal autenticado. Soporta integraciones con conocimiento y acciones de CRM simultáneamente.

question: Universal Containers wants to implement a customer verification process where sensitive account information can only be accessed after the customer passes identity verification. The agent must enforce this security rule deterministically without allowing the LLM to bypass the verification requirement. What should an Agentforce Specialist recommend as the best solution?
options: Use context variables to store verification status in the messaging session and configure the agent to check these variables through natural language prompts during each sensitive action.
Include detailed verification instructions in the agent's topic instructions explaining when customers should be verified and rely on the LLM to follow these guidelines consistently.

Create a custom variable IsCustomerVerified set by a verification action, then apply a conditional filter using the expression IsCustomerVerified equals true to all sensitive data actions, ensuring deterministic access control that the LLM can't alter.
explanation: Crear una variable personalizada y filtros condicionales asegura un control de acceso determinista para acciones sensibles. Depender únicamente de las instrucciones del LLM no garantiza el cumplimiento estricto.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to ensure their custom agent action performs as expected in conversations. What should the Agentforce Specialist focus on when creating action instructions?
options: Write concise agent action instructions and test in Agentforce Builder.
Ensure the agent action label matches the utterance's intent.
Include comprehensive detailed descriptions and perform smoke testing.
explanation: Las instrucciones de acción deben ser concisas y probarse de forma iterativa en Agentforce Builder. Descripciones demasiado extensas pueden confundir al modelo y afectar el rendimiento del agente.

question: Universal Containers has a requirement to provide a sales summary for its sales reps who are using Employee Agents, but they are not happy with the default answer. Which best practice should the AgentForce Specialist recommend?
options: Create a Record Summary custom prompt template.
Create a Knowledge Answer custom prompt template.
Update the standard record summary action.
explanation: Crear un Record Summary prompt template personalizado es la mejor práctica para ajustar resúmenes de datos estructurados. Esto permite adaptar la terminología y el formato a las necesidades de la empresa sin afectar acciones globales.

question: A business stakeholder wants to use AI to generate a summary based on Data Cloud data. Which method(s) should the stakeholder use to access Data Cloud data from Prompt Builder?
options: Accessing data model objects (DMOs) directly in Flex templates, using Data Cloud related lists, and fetching Data Cloud data using prompt-initiated flows
Using Data Cloud related lists and fetching Data Cloud data using prompt-initiated flows
Using only external APIs to import Data Cloud data into Prompt Builder
explanation: Para acceder a datos de Data Cloud desde Prompt Builder se pueden usar DMOs en Flex templates, listas relacionadas y flujos iniciados por prompt. Estas opciones ofrecen flexibilidad y son complementarias.

question: Universal Containers is rolling out a new generative AI initiative. Which Prompt Builder limitations should the Agentforce Specialist be aware of?
options: Rich text area fields are only supported in Flex template types.
Creations or updates to the prompt templates are not recorded in the Setup Audit Trail.
Custom objects are supported only for Flex template types.
explanation: Una limitación de Prompt Builder es que sus creaciones y actualizaciones no se guardan en el Setup Audit Trail. Esto es crucial para organizaciones con auditorías estrictas de configuración.

question: Universal Containers needs to bring individual customer warranties from an external system into Data Cloud. They want Agentforce to return warranty-related responses only for accounts whose warranty status is active. Which search approach should the Agentforce Specialist configure?
options: Depend on Agentforce instructions to enforce warranty constraints and include only WarrantyStatus = Active results.
Store the account's warranty status in an Agentforce custom variable to dynamically filter warranties during retrieval.
Use Hybrid Search and apply pre-filtering in a new custom retriever for matching accounts where the WarrantyStatus = Active field.
explanation: Aplicar prefiltrado en un retriever personalizado con Hybrid Search asegura resultados precisos de forma determinista. Confiar solo en las instrucciones del agente es riesgoso para reglas de negocio críticas.

question: How does Agentforce select the correct action to resolve a user's request?
options: Each topic contains a list of the matching action's user utterances so that the agent can map the user request to the right topic and action.
The large language model (LLM) selects the right topic and action, if they exist. If there are no matches, the LLM attempts to answer the user's request.
The reasoning engine identifies the agent action to be executed by its name and action input instructions.
explanation: El LLM de Agentforce evalúa y selecciona el tema y la acción más apropiados según las instrucciones. Si no hay coincidencias, intentará responder usando su conocimiento general.

question: Universal Containers recently attended a major trade show and received thousands of new leads from event badge scans. Leadership wants to: qualify and nurture leads 24/7, provide accurate answers to prospect questions, automatically book meetings with qualified prospects, and free up reps to focus on closing deals. Which Agentforce capability should UC implement?
options: SDR Agent
Sales Coach
Commerce Agent
explanation: SDR Agent automatiza la calificación de leads, responde consultas y programa reuniones de forma continua. Está diseñado específicamente para potenciar el desarrollo de ventas y la generación de pipeline.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts (CCR) wants to configure its agent so that booking actions are only available when a customer's membership tier is 'Premium' or 'Elite'. This business rule must be enforced deterministically. What should CCR implement?
options: Set up custom validation rules on the underlying booking objects to prevent non-eligible customers from completing bookings.
Configure topic instructions that clearly state booking actions should only be used for Premium or Elite customers and include examples.
Create a context variable mapped to the customer's membership tier field, then add a conditional filter on MembershipTier.
explanation: La forma más determinista de aplicar reglas de negocio es usar una variable de contexto con un filtro condicional. Las instrucciones basadas en temas no garantizan el cumplimiento constante por parte del LLM.

question: An account manager is preparing for an upcoming customer call and wishes to get a snapshot of key data points from accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities in Salesforce. Which feature provides this?
options: Sales Summaries
Sales Insight Summary
Work Summaries
explanation: Sales Insight Summaries ofrece un resumen rápido de cuentas, contactos y oportunidades para preparar al mánager antes de una llamada. Work Summaries es exclusivo para casos de servicio.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts wants to cover a broad range of user phrasing when testing its FAQ agent. Which Testing Center feature meets that need?
options: AI-generated synthetic test utterances based on natural language variations
Uploading only a small set of manually written prompts
Relying on live customer logs to capture phrasing diversity after deployment
explanation: El Testing Center usa IA para generar expresiones sintéticas basadas en variaciones naturales del lenguaje. Esto permite probar una amplia diversidad de consultas sin requerir datos reales de producción.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to deploy an Agentforce Service Agent to support customers via a web experience. UC uses a Digital Experience site and wants to enable messaging for logged-in users. The customer needs to pass the membership number to the agent for which a pre-chat variable is available. What is a required step to connect the agent to the Digital Experience site using Messaging for In-App and Web?
options: Configure a messaging Lightning web component using standard or custom Lightning Type for Agentforce.
Create an Omni-Channel flow that routes messages to the agent.
Configure MuleSoft to establish a secure API tunnel between the agent and the Digital Experience site.
explanation: Es necesario crear un flujo Omnicanal para enrutar los mensajes de un sitio de Experiencia Digital al Agente de Servicio. Este flujo también administra las variables previas al chat.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to improve the productivity of its sales team with generative AI technology. However, UC is concerned that public AI virtual assistants lack adequate company data to generate useful responses. Which solution should UC consider?
options: Fine-tune the Einstein AI model with CRM data.
Build AI model with Einstein discovery and deploy to sales users.
Enable Agentforce and deploy to sales users.
explanation: Agentforce puede utilizar los datos del CRM de Salesforce para proporcionar respuestas contextualizadas a los usuarios. Esta solución no requiere ajustar modelos ni crear desarrollos desde cero.

question: After a successful implementation of Agentforce Sales Agent with sales users, Universal Containers now aims to deploy it to the service team. Which key consideration should the Agentforce Specialist keep in mind for this deployment?
options: Assign the Agentforce for Service permission to the Service Cloud users.
Assign the standard service actions to Agentforce Service Agent.
Review and test standard and custom Agent topics and actions for Service Center use cases.
explanation: Antes de implementar el agente en el área de servicio, es clave revisar y probar los temas y acciones personalizados. Las configuraciones de ventas pueden no ser adecuadas para flujos de servicio.

question: Universal Containers (UC) needs to improve the agent productivity in replying to customer chats. Which generative AI feature should help UC address this issue?
options: Case Summaries
Service Replies
Case Escalation
explanation: Service Replies sugiere respuestas en tiempo real, incrementando la productividad al reducir el tiempo de escritura del agente. Case Summaries no asiste de forma interactiva durante un chat.

question: Universal Containers wants to systematically validate agent responses before deployment using a scalable testing process. Which Testing Center approach should the company implement?
options: Upload a structured CSV test template and run batch test cases in Testing Center.
Manually interact with the agent in Builder until responses seem correct.
Use pilot users in production to flag incorrect responses post-launch.
explanation: Cargar un CSV estructurado para pruebas en lote es la forma más escalable de validar el agente en el Testing Center. Esto permite realizar pruebas masivas sin consumir solicitudes de Einstein.

question: Universal Containers aims to streamline the sales team's daily tasks by using AI. When considering these new workflows, which improvement requires the use of Prompt Builder?
options: Populate an AI-generated time-to-close estimation to opportunities
Populate an AI-generated summary field for sales contracts.
Populate an AI-generated lead score for new leads.
explanation: Se requiere Prompt Builder para generar y poblar un campo de resumen con IA en contratos de ventas. Otras estimaciones como lead score se basan en modelos predictivos y no en esta herramienta.

question: Universal Containers (UC) uses standard Service AI Grounding. UC created a custom rich text field to be used with Service AI Grounding. What should UC consider when using standard Service AI Grounding?
options: Service AI Grounding only works with Case and Knowledge objects.
Service AI Grounding only supports String and Text Area type fields.
Service AI Grounding visibility works in system mode.
explanation: Service AI Grounding solo soporta campos de tipo String y Text Area. Los campos Rich Text no son compatibles con esta funcionalidad.

question: Universal Containers implemented Agent for its users. One user complains that Agent is not deleting activities from the past 7 days. What is the reason for this issue?
options: Agent Delete Record Action permission is not associated to the user.
Agent does not have the permission to delete the user's records.
Agent does not support the Delete Record action.
explanation: Agentforce Agent no incluye la acción de eliminar registros para prevenir borrados accidentales. Solo admite crear, actualizar, consultar y resumir información.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is implementing Agentforce Service Agent on Email. UC made an email template and now needs to connect it to a Service Agent. What should an Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Create an Email Configuration for the Service Agent.
Create an Omni-Channel flow to point to an email template.
No action needed; the Service Agent connects automatically.
explanation: Se debe crear una Email Configuration para vincular un template de correo con el Service Agent. Esto establece la conexión necesaria entre el canal y el agente.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to empower its marketing team with AI capabilities that help employees quickly find campaign data, generate creative content, and manage project tasks. The solution should also allow marketers to receive personalized support, surface relevant information, and complete work directly in Salesforce. Which AI solution should UC implement?
options: Sales Coach Agent
Service Agent
Employee Agent
explanation: Un Agente Empleado es ideal para ayudar a los equipos internos a gestionar proyectos, buscar datos y generar contenido. Incrementa la productividad en los flujos diarios.

question: Universal Containers needs to create Data Cloud reports to understand agent behavior. Which data lake object (DLO) represents an overarching container capturing contiguous interactions with one or more AI agents?
options: AIAgentInteraction
AIAgentInteractionMessage
AIAgentSession
explanation: AIAgentSession es el objeto principal (DLO) que consolida interacciones continuas con los agentes de IA. Los otros objetos capturan detalles a nivel de interacción individual o de mensaje.

question: The Agentforce Specialist for Cloud Kicks wants to create an agent that will allow the sales staff to schedule their daily tasks and assist in providing detailed explanations behind product prices and deals. Following Salesforce best practices, which type of agent should they create?
options: Service Agent
Employee Agent
Sales Agent
explanation: Sales Agent es el tipo idóneo para asistir a los vendedores con sus tareas y detalles de productos. Está especialmente diseñado para flujos de ventas y gestión de oportunidades.

question: What is the primary advantage of creating an individual retriever instead of the default retriever?
options: Individual retrievers can aggregate multiple data spaces and data model objects (DMOs) into a unified retriever output.
Individual retrievers allow the configuration of filters, specified fields, and how many results are returned.
Individual retrievers automatically generate new search indexes and dynamically update vectors.
explanation: Un retriever individual permite ajustar filtros, campos y límite de resultados. Esto brinda mayor control y precisión que la configuración predeterminada.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts needs consistent pass/fail logic for agent testing. Which Testing Center capability provides that?
options: Use customer rating as a proxy for correctness.
Run a script on event logs to identify the failed utterances.
Use structured batch testing with validation per test utterance.
explanation: Las pruebas estructuradas por lote en Testing Center aseguran resultados objetivos por cada expresión. Esto permite una validación consistente y sistemática de las respuestas.

question: Universal Containers is building a digital shopping assistant that needs to dynamically generate product recommendations using information from the company's external product recommendation predictive model through APIs. Which Agentforce capability should make it easier for the agent to consume the external product recommendation tool?
options: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Hugging Face
Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol
explanation: Model Context Protocol (MCP) permite al agente descubrir y usar herramientas y APIs externas dinámicamente. Facilita la integración estandarizada sin necesidad de código personalizado.

question: When is the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol an appropriate communication choice?
options: When agents need to invoke third-party APIs
When agents need to access tools
When agents need to collaborate
explanation: El protocolo Agent-to-Agent (A2A) se utiliza para la colaboración y comunicación entre agentes, permitiendo delegar tareas o compartir contexto. Para invocar APIs o herramientas, se debe usar MCP en su lugar.

question: Universal Containers has multiple Salesforce orgs, each with a unique customer service agent where a verification agent must pass customer identity data to downstream agents handling account modifications. The customer ID must remain secure and persistent across agent handoffs without exposure to LLM modification. What is the most appropriate configuration?
options: Implement a custom object to temporarily store verification status and have each agent query it via SOQL actions during execution.
Store customer identity information in conversation variables created by the first agent and have other agents read those same conversation variables.
Use the Agent API to start the downstream agent's session and pass the verified customer ID as a read-only context variable, ensuring security and preventing LLM alteration.
explanation: La solución más segura es usar la Agent API para iniciar la sesión del agente secundario y pasar el ID de cliente como una variable de contexto de solo lectura. Esto garantiza la seguridad y evita que el LLM modifique datos críticos.

question: Which scenario best illustrates the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) in an enterprise AI deployment?
options: A legal assistant agent using MCP to dynamically find a document classification API to analyze case files
A customer service agent engaging another agent in real-time conversation to resolve tickets
A sales agent discovering other agents' capabilities using Agent Cards
explanation: MCP se utiliza principalmente para que un agente descubra y se conecte a herramientas y APIs externas, como una de clasificación de documentos. La colaboración entre agentes corresponde al protocolo A2A.

question: A developer is using the Salesforce CLI to deploy agent components from a sandbox to production. They recently made changes to several topics, instructions, and actions. Which metadata component should the developer include in their package.xml file that contains all of the topics and actions an agent will interact with?
options: genAiPlannerBundle
EinsteinAiPlannerBundle
BotBundle
explanation: El componente 'genAiPlannerBundle' agrupa todos los temas (topics) y acciones de un agente de Agentforce. Es el metadato correcto a incluir en el package.xml al desplegar mediante Salesforce CLI.

question: Universal Containers (UC) needs to capture and store detailed interaction data for all agents. Which feature should help UC get a full view of the agent's behavior from start to finish, including reasoning engine executions, actions, prompt and gateway inputs/outputs, error messages, and final responses?
options: Agentforce Analytics
Utterance Analysis
Agentforce Session Tracing
explanation: Agentforce Session Tracing ofrece una vista detallada de todo el comportamiento del agente, incluyendo el motor de razonamiento, acciones y errores. Es la herramienta ideal para un análisis exhaustivo de las sesiones.

question: At Universal Containers, a sales manager is tackling a tough challenge as several new junior sales reps struggle with objection handling and price negotiations for complex deals. The manager lacks the time to personally guide each sales rep through their specific customer scenarios before their critical meetings. The junior sales reps have asked for a tool that would allow them to practice their pitches by simulating tough conversations and receive personalized feedback that is specific to the commerce opportunity they are working on. Which Salesforce solution should an Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Employee Coach
SDR Agent
Sales Coach
explanation: Salesforce ofrece 'Sales Coach', un agente interactivo que simula conversaciones basadas en oportunidades reales. Permite a los representantes practicar tácticas de ventas y recibir retroalimentación personalizada.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is assisting Universal Containers with troubleshooting an agent. The Agentforce Specialist notices that the agent is not using topic actions in the desired sequence, causing inconsistent outcomes. Which technique should the Agentforce Specialist recommend to ensure deterministic control over the order in which actions are executed?
options: Specify the large language model (LLM) provider and version.
Specify custom variables and filters.
Specify the order of actions.
explanation: Para controlar el orden de ejecución de las acciones de forma determinista, se deben utilizar variables personalizadas y filtros condicionales. Esto asegura que cada acción se ejecute solo cuando se cumplan las condiciones previas.

question: A Service Agent at Universal Containers is designed to help customers resolve issues by searching against knowledge articles. Knowledge articles have PDF attachments that add critical details. UC reports that the agent provides excellent summaries of the knowledge articles, but seems completely unaware of the PDF attachments. How should an Agentforce Specialist configure the Data Cloud search index to include the content of these attached files?
options: Increase article chunk size and token limits for Knowledge indexing so larger contexts capture attachment references.
Enable 'Include Related Attachments' for Knowledge--kav and map the ContentDocumentLink unstructured data model object (UDMO).
Use Data Cloud's 'Include Attachments' option and select the ContentDocumentVersion unstructured data model object (UDMO).
explanation: Para indexar el contenido de los archivos PDF adjuntos a artículos de Knowledge, se debe utilizar la opción 'Include Attachments' en Data Cloud. Se debe seleccionar el UDMO ContentDocumentVersion para permitir la búsqueda semántica.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to connect an Agentforce Service Agent to a Slack channel for employee use. Which step should an Agentforce Specialist take to connect the agent with a Slack channel?
options: Create a connection between Salesforce and the Slack workspace.
Create an Omni-Channel flow and connection between Salesforce and the Slack workspace.
Create an embedded service deployment and connection between Salesforce and the Slack workspace.
explanation: El paso previo fundamental para conectar un agente de Agentforce a Slack es crear una conexión entre los espacios de trabajo de Salesforce y Slack. Esto habilita la interacción del agente con los usuarios a través de los canales.

question: Universal Containers has a new AI project. What should an Agentforce Specialist consider when adding a related list on the Account object to be used in the prompt template?
options: After selecting a related list from the Account, use the field picker to choose merge fields in Prompt Builder.
Prompt Builder must be used to assign the fields from the related list as a JSON format.
The fields for the related list are based on the default page layout of the Account for the current user.
explanation: Al usar una lista relacionada (related list) en Prompt Builder, los campos disponibles dependen del diseño de página (page layout) predeterminado del usuario actual. Los campos no incluidos en el diseño no podrán usarse como campos de combinación.

question: Universal Containers (UC) needs to save agents time with AI-generated case summaries. UC has implemented the Work Summary feature. What does Einstein consider when generating a summary?
options: Generation is grounded with conversation context, Knowledge articles, and cases.
Generation is grounded with existing conversation context only.
Generation is grounded with conversation context and Knowledge articles.
explanation: Einstein Work Summaries se basa en el contexto de la conversación, los artículos de Knowledge y los casos. Estos tres elementos fundamentan la generación de resúmenes precisos.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is setting up a new Agentforce Service Agent. The company has sensitive medical product research stored internally and wants to ensure the agent cannot access it. What should UC do?
options: Assign the Agentforce Service Agent user the lowest possible role in the organization's hierarchy to block access.
Disable the Agentforce Service Agent's ability to use any Salesforce custom object or related fields.
Follow the principle of least privilege and avoid granting permission to view the Medical Product object or related fields.
explanation: Se debe seguir el principio de mínimo privilegio y no otorgar al usuario del agente acceso al objeto Medical Product ni a sus campos. Esto garantiza que la información confidencial quede restringida.

question: A data science team has trained an XGBoost classification model for product recommendations on Databricks. The Agentforce Specialist is tasked with bringing inferences for product recommendations from this model into Data Cloud as a stand-alone data model object (DMO). How should the Agentforce Specialist set this up?
options: Create the serving endpoint in Databricks, then configure the model using Model Builder.
Create the serving endpoint in Einstein Studio, then configure the model using Model Builder.
Create the serving endpoint in Databricks, then configure the model using a Python SDK connector.
explanation: Para integrar un modelo XGBoost en Data Cloud, primero se debe crear el endpoint de servicio en Databricks. Luego, este endpoint se configura utilizando Model Builder en Salesforce para procesar las inferencias.

question: An Agentforce Specialist builds a new Service Agent that uses a custom action built on a flow. The agent has been tested in a sandbox and is now ready to deploy. What is a key consideration regarding the activation status of the agent in the production environment?
options: The agent will be activated automatically only if the flow is also active.
The agent must be manually activated in production, regardless of its status in the sandbox.
The agent will automatically be activated upon successful deployment.
explanation: Los agentes implementados en producción deben activarse manualmente tras un despliegue exitoso. El estado de activación del entorno sandbox no se transfiere automáticamente.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to troubleshoot an agent that is hallucinating weblinks. The agent has an action that uses a prompt template, which is using a knowledge retriever, to generate the output text. Which process is appropriate to find the root cause of the hallucination behavior?
options: Examine the topic name and classification description for hallucination guardrails.
Examine the prompt instructions and contents of the chunks shown in the resolved prompt output.
Examine the topic instructions and ensure the word 'ALWAYS' is used in the hallucination guardrails.
explanation: Para identificar la causa de alucinaciones con enlaces web, se deben revisar las instrucciones del prompt y el contenido de los fragmentos (chunks) resueltos. Esto permite determinar si el error proviene de los datos fuente o del LLM.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts is implementing Agentforce retrieval. Customers sometimes type ambiguous terms (for example, 'package' could mean vacation package or baggage). Which retrieval strategy best balances precision and contextual disambiguation?
options: Use hybrid search, which combines keyword matching for precision with semantic embeddings for context.
Use semantic search only, which captures intent but may struggle with ambiguous terms when no context is provided.
Use keyword search only, which prioritizes exact term matching but risks missing contextual meaning.
explanation: La búsqueda híbrida es la mejor estrategia, ya que combina la precisión de la coincidencia de palabras clave con el contexto de los embeddings semánticos. Es ideal para manejar términos ambiguos de manera efectiva.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts needs to ensure its booking agent executes actions in a specific sequence: first retrieve available sessions, then verify customer eligibility, and finally create the booking. The current implementation allows the LLM to execute these actions in any order, causing booking failures. Which approach should an Agentforce Specialist implement?
options: Write comprehensive topic instructions detailing the exact sequence of actions using numbered steps and explicit ordering requirements for the reasoning engine to follow.

Create custom variables that store completion status for each step, then implement conditional filters on subsequent actions requiring previous variables to be populated, ensuring deterministic execution order.
Configure topic, classification description, and action instructions with priority levels and sequence indicators to guide the reasoning engine in selecting the correct action order automatically.
explanation: Para asegurar una ejecución determinista y secuencial, se deben crear variables personalizadas para el estado de cada paso y aplicar filtros condicionales en las siguientes acciones. Esto evita que el LLM altere el orden de ejecución.

question: Universal Containers (UC) plans to deploy an Agentforce Service Agent and wants to enable Agentforce in Slack so teams can interact with agents directly in Slack channels. Which description represents the key steps required to enable Agentforce in Slack?
options: Enable the default Slack channel Agentforce, and assign Slack agent access to users.
Configure the Slack workflow to invoke the Agentforce API, enabling users to interact with agents through predefined triggers and automated steps.
Configure the Slack agent connection and, in Manage Agentforce, install the agent, then assign agent access to users.
explanation: Para habilitar Agentforce en Slack, se debe configurar la conexión del agente, instalarlo en Manage Agentforce y asignar el acceso a los usuarios. Este proceso de tres pasos garantiza la correcta integración.

question: During configuration, Universal Containers (UC) forgot to grant Knowledge access to the Agentforce Service Agent. Which permission must UC add for the agent to interact with Knowledge articles and answer customer questions effectively?
options: Allow View Knowledge and Run Flows
Access Knowledge records and fields, and Allow View Knowledge
Access Custom Objects and Manage External Users
explanation: El agente requiere los permisos 'Access Knowledge records and fields' y 'Allow View Knowledge'. Ambos son necesarios para que pueda buscar y leer artículos de la base de conocimiento de forma efectiva.

question: A service manager wants to use Salesforce Prompt Builder to help agents summarize customer case notes after a support call. The summary should: capture the customer's issue, troubleshooting steps taken, and next actions; be no longer than five sentences; use plain language; and if no next action is identified, explicitly state 'No next action required.' Which prompt template follows Salesforce prompt design best practices?
options: Role: You are an experienced support agent. Task: Summarize the case notes. Context: Include customer issue, troubleshooting steps, and next actions. Constraints: Limit to 5 sentences, use plain language, and if no next action is found, state 'No next action required.' Format: Use numbered sentences for clarity.

Role: You are a support agent writing a case summary. Task: Provide a professional summary. Context: Include customer issue, steps taken, and next actions if available. Constraints: No strict sentence limit, but use plain language. If no next action is found, leave it out. Format: Use paragraphs.

Role: You are a case documentation assistant. Task: Write a summary of the support call. Context: Always describe the customer issue, troubleshooting, and resolution details. Constraints: The summary should be comprehensive and professional, but there is no limit on length or language style.
explanation: El mejor prompt define claramente el rol, la tarea, el contexto, el formato y restricciones específicas como el límite de oraciones y el lenguaje sencillo. Esto asegura una respuesta profesional y estructurada sin ambigüedades.

question: An Agentforce Specialist needs to enable the use of Sales Email prompt templates for the sales team. The Agentforce Specialist has already created the templates in Prompt Builder. According to best practices, which steps should the Agentforce Specialist take to ensure the sales team can use these templates?
options: Assign the Prompt Template User permission set and enable Sales Emails in Setup.
Assign the Data Cloud Admin permission set and enable Sales Emails in Setup.
Assign the Prompt Template Manager permission set and enable Sales Emails in Setup.
explanation: Se debe asignar el conjunto de permisos 'Prompt Template User' al equipo de ventas. Además, es necesario activar la funcionalidad 'Sales Emails' en la configuración de Salesforce.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is expanding its Agentforce for Service capabilities to include case management. For security purposes, UC wants the agent to verify a customer's identity before providing any case-related information. The verification must be deterministic ensuring that no case details are shared unless identity verification has been successfully completed. Which approach best meets this requirement?
options: Create a variable to store the verification status, set it as output from a "Verify Identity" action, and apply a filter so any case-related actions only run when the variable confirms verification.
Use keywords such as "Always" and "Never" to write clear logic in Topic Instructions to verify user identity before providing any case information.
Store the verification status in a custom variable and set a global instruction that the agent should check this variable before sharing case information.
explanation: La forma más segura y determinista es usar una variable para almacenar el estado de verificación y aplicar un filtro en las acciones de gestión de casos. Así, el agente solo compartirá información si la verificación es exitosa.

question: Cloud Kicks wants to integrate its agent with its custom website. The goal is for customers to interact with the custom agent chat interface. Which approach provides the framework for the custom web application to communicate with the agent?
options: Agent API
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Agent to Agent (A2A)
explanation: La Agent API es la interfaz REST que permite a aplicaciones o sitios web personalizados conectarse de manera programática con Agentforce. Es el marco ideal para enviar y recibir mensajes desde un chat externo.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is preparing to use the Agentforce Testing Center to ensure the reliability of a new agent. UC has a CSV file with test cases and is reviewing the documentation to understand best practices and limitations. Which best practice should the company follow to avoid modifying CRM data while running tests in the Testing Center?
options: Limit the number of test cases to 50 per test to minimize data changes.
Use the Testing Center only in the sandbox environment.
Run tests in the production environment to ensure real time data accuracy.
explanation: Las pruebas en el Testing Center deben realizarse exclusivamente en un entorno Sandbox. Esto previene cualquier alteración o corrupción de los datos reales de producción.

question: Universal Containers has PDF maintenance guides in an external folder, not yet in Salesforce. The team wants a standard, clicks- only setup for the Service Agent to use these documents. Which approach should the Agentforce Specialist implement?
options: Paste external PDF links into topic instructions and rely on the model to follow them, avoiding configuration of a retrieval source, index, or retriever action.
Upload the PDFs as File source in the Agentforce Data Library which will build a Search Index, and create a retriever to ground responses from those documents.
Configure Data Cloud to ingest file attachments and create custom index and retriever for product record and attachment dat
explanation: Los documentos PDF deben subirse como 'File source' en la Agentforce Data Library, lo que generará automáticamente un índice de búsqueda. Luego, se configura una acción 'retriever' para que el agente recupere el contexto.

question: An Agentforce Specialist needs to create a prompt template that extracts the customer's name, phone number, and case number from a block of text, and nothing else. How should the Agentforce Specialist structure the prompt to ensure the large language model (LLM) doesn't include extra conversation or text?
options: Ask the LLM to extract and only output the important information in the text.
Use well-defined output instructions and provide desired output examples.
Ensure in the prompt that the LLM has been told to only use name value pairs in the response.
explanation: Para garantizar que el LLM extraiga información precisa sin añadir texto extra, se deben proporcionar instrucciones de salida claras y ejemplos del formato esperado. Esto guía al modelo para devolver únicamente datos estructurados.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts is uploading thousands of new HTML knowledge articles files for a resort launch. To ensure Agentforce retrieves accurate responses quickly, which chunking strategy should be used when creating a new index?
options: Conversation-based chunking
Semantic based passage extraction
Section-aware chunking
explanation: Para documentos estructurados en HTML, la estrategia 'Section-aware chunking' es ideal porque divide el texto usando sus etiquetas (como h1 y h2). Esto preserva el sentido lógico y mejora la recuperación semántica.

question: Which statement explains why a company might prefer a hybrid search index in Data Cloud for Agentforce?
options: Vector embeddings in hybrid search are prefiltered by keyword matches, reducing computational overhead and improving response accuracy.
Hybrid search indexes process queries faster than vector search because they eliminate the need for semantic embedding.
Hybrid search indexes support both literal keyword matches and semantic recall, useful when queries mix specific terms and intent.
explanation: La búsqueda híbrida combina la precisión exacta de las palabras clave con la comprensión semántica de los vectores. Es ideal cuando las consultas incluyen tanto lenguaje natural como identificadores específicos.

question: What does it mean when a prompt template version is described as immutable?
options: Every modification on a template will be saved as a new version automatically.
After a prompt template version is activated, no further changes can be saved to that version.
Only the latest version of a template can be activated.
explanation: Una vez que una versión de una plantilla de prompt es activada o guardada como final, se vuelve inmutable y no puede ser modificada. Cualquier cambio requiere la creación y activación de una nueva versión.

question: Which best practice should UC follow to grant access to this information for the Agentforce Service Agent?
options: Update the Object and Field access in the Einstein Agent User Profile so that the Agentforce Service Agents will always get the necessary access.
Update the Object and Field access in the AgentforceServiceAgentUserPsg permission set group that is already assigned to the Agentforce Service Agent user.
Create a new permission set with the Einstein Agent License and enable Read access to the custom fields and custom objects, and assign it to the Agentforce Service Agent user.
explanation: Se debe actualizar el grupo de conjuntos de permisos predeterminado del agente (como AgentforceServiceAgentUserPsg). Otorgar acceso de lectura explícito a los campos necesarios garantiza el cumplimiento del principio de menor privilegio.

question: Universal Containers needs to restrict access to refund processing actions so only customers with Active account status can initiate refunds. How should an Agentforce Specialist apply the restriction deterministically?
options: Create a context variable for the account status field and apply a conditional filter AccountStatus equals "Active" to refund actions.
OInclude step-by-step instructions at the topic level and action level explaining the rules and examples.
Create a Flex Prompt Template that has instructions to check for account status.
explanation: Se debe crear una variable de contexto para el estado de la cuenta y aplicar un filtro condicional que exija 'AccountStatus = Active' en la acción de reembolso. Esto garantiza que el agente no ejecute la acción sin cumplir el requisito.

question: Cloud Kicks (CK) recently finished the development of a new prompt template that uses its own large language model (LLM). CK is deploying a prompt template from a sandbox to a production org, and is receiving an error. When trying to deploy the change set, CK is getting an error related to the LLM used in the prompt template. What is the cause of the error?
options: The prompt does not specify that it is a custom LLM.
The name of the LLM does not match in sandbox and production.
BYOLLM is not yet supported for in prompt templates in production.
explanation: Al desplegar un LLM personalizado mediante Change Sets, el nombre de la API del modelo debe coincidir exactamente entre Sandbox y Producción. Si no coinciden, el despliegue fallará al no encontrar la dependencia.

question: An administrator at Universal Containers has successfully deployed a new agent from a sandbox to production using a change set. The agent uses a prompt template that invokes a Salesforce flow to perform a complex calculation. In production, when users interact with the agent, it fails with an error message every time the flow is supposed to run. The flow was included in the change set and is present in production. What is the most likely cause of this issue?
options: The change set did not include the dependent Apex classes for the flow.
The flow was not manually activated in the production org after the deployment.
The user in production does not have permission to run the flow.
explanation: Los flujos desplegados mediante Change Sets llegan a Producción en estado inactivo por defecto. El administrador debe activar el flujo manualmente para que el agente pueda ejecutarlo sin errores.

question: Universal Containers' administrator has developed a new agent in a sandbox environment and now wants to deploy it to production. What should the administrator do to deploy an agent?
options: Export agent components as JSON files and manually import them into production using the Metadata API.
Create an outbound change set with all the necessary agent components, then upload to production.
Manually recreate the agent configuration, topics, and actions in production because change sets cannot be used.
explanation: La configuración completa de un agente, incluyendo temas y acciones, representa metadatos nativos de Salesforce. El método oficial para migrarlo a producción es mediante un conjunto de cambios saliente (outbound change set).

question: Universal Containers is setting up the data library configuration within the Agentforce Builder. What is true regarding Agentforce Data Libraries?
options: An agent can have only one data library assigned to it.
Each data category can only have one data library.
Only data library owners can assign it to the agent.
explanation: Un agente de Agentforce solo puede estar conectado a una única Data Library. Esta biblioteca debe consolidar todas las fuentes de datos y conocimientos que el agente necesitará para responder.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is preparing and defining success criteria for Agentforce Testing Center test cases. Which details should UC specify as the expected output to ensure the tests accurately reflect the agent's functionality?
options: Expected Topic API Name
Expected Flow API Name
Expected Prompt Template Name
explanation: Para validar que el agente clasifica correctamente la intención del usuario, se debe verificar que selecciona el tema adecuado. Esto se define como el 'Expected Topic API Name' en el Testing Center.

question: An Agentforce Specialist at Universal Containers (UC) is building with no-code tools only. They have many small accounts that are only touched periodically by a specialized sales team, and UC wants to maximize the sales operations team's time. UC wants to help prep the sales team for calls by: • Summarizing past purchases • Displaying products the contact has shown interest in (with data captured via Data Cloud) • Providing a recap of past email and phone conversations that have transcripts Which approach should the Agentforce Specialist recommend to achieve this goal?
options: Deploy UC's own custom foundational model on this data first.
Use a prompt template grounded on CRM and Data Cloud data using standard foundation models.
Fine tune the standard foundational model due to the complexity of the dat
explanation: La mejor opción no-code es usar Prompt Builder con una plantilla fundamentada en datos de CRM y Data Cloud. Esto aprovecha los modelos estándar sin la necesidad de entrenar un LLM personalizado.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to ensure its compliance team can retrieve exact matches of policy clause numbers from a structured legal document library. Which search type should UC implement?
options: Use hybrid search to blend keyword and semantic recall.
Use keyword search for exact term matching on structured fields like clause numbers.
Use semantic search to interpret synonyms of clauses dynamically.
explanation: Para coincidencias exactas de términos específicos como números de cláusulas, se debe usar la búsqueda por palabras clave (keyword search). La búsqueda semántica no es tan precisa para identificar valores alfanuméricos literales.

question: A company wants to retrieve patient history details to augment the AI agent response. The company wants to leverage the Data Cloud search index feature. What is best practice when considering retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for information that may contain personally identifiable information (PII)?
options: Mask sensitive fields and index only non-PII dat
Depend on the agent's prompt to avoid exposing PII.
Encrypt embeddings, but still index PII records.
explanation: La información confidencial (PII) debe enmascararse o excluirse antes de generar los vectores y el índice en Data Cloud. Esto asegura que los datos sensibles no lleguen al modelo ni al contexto de recuperación.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is building a Flex prompt template. UC needs to use data returned by the flow in the prompt template. Which flow element should UC use?
options: Add Flow Instructions
Add Flex Instructions
Add Prompt Instructions
explanation: En el Flow Builder, se debe usar el elemento lógico 'Add Prompt Instructions' para procesar los datos devueltos por el flujo. Esto formatea correctamente la información antes de enviarla a la plantilla de Flex Prompt.

question: An administrator at Universal Containers is setting up a new Sales Development Representative (SDR) Agent. The agent's purpose is to nurture cold leads before connecting them to the assigned sales rep. To ensure the agent has all the necessary access to the leads in the North America sales region, what should the administrator do?
options: Assign the user in the highest-level role within the North America role hierarchy as the SDR Agent User.
Grant View All record permission of the Lead object to the 'Einstein Agent User' profile.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule to grant access to targeted lead records to SDR Agent User.
explanation: Para dar acceso a registros específicos sin otorgar permisos excesivos, se debe implementar una regla de colaboración basada en criterios (criteria-based sharing rule). Esta regla se debe asignar al usuario del agente.

question: Universal Containers has set up a Service Agent to allow customers to look up their order status. The topic setup includes: Name: Order Inquiry Classification Description: Handles user requests to look up order status, including tracking details and delivery estimates for orders placed within the last 90 days. Scope: Your job is only to assist authenticated users in looking up the status of their orders placed within the last 90 days. If the order is pending delivery, provide the tracking number and estimated delivery date. Do not handle inquiries for orders older than 90 days. Which information will be used by the Agentforce reasoning engine to choose this topic?
options: Topic Name and Classification Description
Topic Name and Scope
Classification Description and Scope
explanation: El motor de razonamiento de Agentforce evalúa el 'Topic Name' y la 'Classification Description'. Estos campos son fundamentales para determinar si la consulta del usuario corresponde al tema.

question: Support agents at Universal Containers are using Agentforce to find troubleshooting information. They've reported that the agent frequently provides knowledge articles that are outdated, even when newer versions of the articles are available. The administrator has confirmed that all articles are correctly chunked and indexed. Which configuration change in the Data Cloud hybrid search index best addresses this problem?
options: Disable the keyword index to rely solely on the vector index.
Switch the chunking strategy from section-aware to fixed-size.
Add a ranking factor for recency based on the LastModifiedDate field.
explanation: Configurar un factor de clasificación basado en 'LastModifiedDate' en Data Cloud prioriza los artículos más recientes. Esto asegura que el agente use el conocimiento más actualizado disponible.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has effectively utilized prompt templates to update summary fields on Lightning record pages. Ant admin now wishes to incorporate similar functionality into UC's automation processes using Flow. How should the admin get a response from this prompt template from within a flow to use as part of UC's automation?
options: Invocable Apex
Einstein for Flow
Flow action
explanation: En Salesforce Flow, las plantillas de prompt se exponen como acciones invocables estándar. Esto permite integrarlas fácilmente en los procesos de automatización de la empresa.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is creating a prompt template to assist support reps in drafting responses to customer complaints. To ensure the responses are empathetic and helpful, what is a key element to include in the prompt template?
options: direct instruction to the large language model (LLM) to role-play as a character
list of keywords related to customer complaints
The entire history of the customer's previous interactions with the company
explanation: Usar la técnica de 'Role-Playing' instruye al LLM a adoptar un personaje específico. Así, la IA puede actuar como un representante empático al responder quejas de clientes.

question: Universal Containers wants to assign agents to improve department efficiency. Which configuration ensures the right tasks are handled by the right agents?
options: SDR Agent for lead qualification, Service Agent for support tickets, Employee Agent for HR requests
Sales Coach Agent for lead and service Agent for HR requests, and Support tickets to ensure cases are available
One Service Agent to efficiently handle each of these scenarios, which reduces the number of agent types needed for support
explanation: Asignar agentes especializados, como SDR para prospectos y Service para soporte, mejora la eficiencia operativa. Cada agente utiliza habilidades específicas para su área.

question: The Agentforce Specialist for Coral Cloud Resorts wants to create an agent that will automate the resolution of a large portion of guest complaints related to their vacation experiences. The agent will be able to offer upgrades, hotel credit, and other complimentary options. The agent will also be in charge of escalating the case to a human when a guest has suffered a major disruption (such as cancellation). Following Salesforce best practices, which type of agent should the Agentforce Specialist create?
options: Sales Agent with a Flex prompt template
Custom Agent with a Flex prompt template
Service Agent with a Flex prompt template
explanation: El Service Agent está diseñado para resolver problemas de servicio al cliente y gestionar quejas. Es la mejor práctica para escenarios de atención al cliente y posibles escalamientos.

question: What is a key benefit of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol?
options: Provides a standardized framework for cross-vendor agent discovery and communication
Allows auto-onboard third-party agents without additional contracts, trust scores, or shared identity controls
Provides a standardized runtime engine for internal agent discovery and communication
explanation: El protocolo Agent-to-Agent (A2A) permite que agentes de diferentes proveedores se descubran y comuniquen de forma segura. Esto facilita la interoperabilidad entre distintos ecosistemas de IA.

question: Universal Containers is indexing millions of product manuals where users may ask both structured queries (model numbers) and natural language Questions (for example, "How do I reset my device?"). Which retrieval approach should the company use?
options: Use keyword search only, since model numbers dominate queries.
Use semantic search only, as natural language is always preferred.
Use hybrid search to combine keyword precision with semantic flexibility.
explanation: La búsqueda híbrida combina la precisión de palabras clave con la flexibilidad de la búsqueda semántica. Es ideal para consultas que mezclan términos estructurados y lenguaje natural.

question: When using a prompt template, what should an Agentforce Specialist consider with their grounding data and chosen model?
options: Review the token limit in the Einstein Trust Layer.
Ensure queries used for grounding employ offset so the token limits of models are not exceeded.
Review the model limitation in Prompt Builder versus the grounding data size.
explanation: Es crucial revisar las limitaciones de tokens del modelo dentro de Prompt Builder frente al tamaño de los datos de grounding. Esto asegura que el contexto total no exceda la capacidad del modelo elegido.

question: Universal Containers wants to test agents while preserving real data and isolating from production. Which environment should the company use with Testing Center?
options: Use personal developer orgs unrepresentative of production dat
Use production org directly with test assertions.
Use sandbox environments replicated from production for safe testing.
explanation: Para probar agentes con Testing Center de forma segura y realista, se deben usar entornos Sandbox como réplicas de producción. Esto permite validar el comportamiento con datos reales sin afectar el entorno productivo.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts wants to handle frequent customer misspellings of package names in queries. Which approach should the Agentforce Specialist implement?
options: Hybrid search
Vector search
Keyword search
explanation: La búsqueda vectora aprovecha las incrustaciones de vectores para comprender errores ortográficos. Combina la búsqueda semántica con palabras clave para obtener resultados óptimos.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has a library of custom-built personalized investment portfolio APIs, and is planning to extend it to agents. Which method should UC's agent choose to dynamically use the best API service?
options: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support
MuleSoft connector for custom hosted processes
explanation: Para que un agente seleccione e invoque dinámicamente la mejor API desde un catálogo de herramientas personalizadas.

question: After an agent selects a topic, what is an important factor the reasoning engine uses to select the action?
options: The priority given to each action
The explicit order of actions in the topic
The name and instructions of the actions
explanation: El reasoning engine evalua la prioridad asignada a cada accion dentro del topic para determinar cual ejecutar primero. Este mecanismo de priorizacion permite controlar el orden de seleccion cuando multiples acciones coinciden con la intencion del usuario.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to troubleshoot their Agent's performance. Where should the Agentforce Specialist go to access all user interactions with the Agent, including Agent errors, incorrectly triggered actions, and incomplete plans?
options: Event Logs
Agent Settings
Plan Canvas
explanation: Event Logs es la herramienta adecuada para revisar detalles de ejecución y hacer troubleshooting del rendimiento del agente. Proporciona información sobre interacciones, errores y acciones activadas.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to implement an Al-powered customer service agent that can  Retrieve proprietary policy documents that are stored as PDFs.  Ensure responses are grounded in approved company data, not generic LLM knowledge. What should UC do first?
options: Add the files to the content, and then select the data library option.
Expand the Al agent's scope to search all Salesforce records.
Set up an Agentforce Data Library for AI retrieval of policy documents.
explanation: El primer paso es configurar una Biblioteca de Datos (Data Library) o índice vectorial en Data Cloud. Esto permite fundamentar las respuestas del agente en los documentos PDF.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is rolling out an Al-powered support assistant to help customer service agents quickly retrieve relevant troubleshooting steps and policy guidelines. The assistant relies on a search index in Data Cloud that contains product manuals, policy documents, and past case resolutions. During testing, UC notices that agents are receiving too many irrelevant results from older product versions that no longer apply. How should UC address this issue?
options: Create a custom retriever in Einstein Studio, and apply filters for publication date and product line.
Use the default retriever, as it already searches the entire search index and provides broad coverage.
Modify the search index to only store documents from the last year and remove older records.
explanation: La mejor solución es crear un 'Custom Retriever' en Einstein Studio para aplicar filtros de metadatos como fecha o línea de productos. Esto mejora la relevancia de la búsqueda sin eliminar datos históricos.

question: Universal Containers' service team wants to customize the standard case summary response from Agentforce. What should the Agentforce Specialist do to achieve this?
options: Customize the standard Record Summary template for the Case object.
Summarize the Case with a standard agent action.
Create a custom Record Summary prompt template for the Case object.
explanation: Se debe crear una plantilla personalizada 'Record Summary prompt template' para el objeto Case. Las acciones de resumen estándar no se pueden editar directamente.

question: A Salesforce Administrator is exploring the capabilities of Agent to enhance user interaction within their organization.
