A formula field concatenating title, body and categories.
explanation: Para artículos largos, se usa un campo resumen como identificador para la búsqueda, mientras que el cuerpo completo actúa como campo de contenido.

question: Universal Containers' development team hears two new Salesforce product names and asks the Agentforce Specialist to clarify: What are Agentforce Vibes and Intelligent Context, respectively?
options: Vibes: an enterprise AI "vibe coding" assistant that generates code (e.g., Apex/LWC) grounded in the org's metadata and governance; Intelligent Context: a managed pipeline that parses, chunks and enriches unstructured content to ground agents.
Two names for the same feature: the conversational view of Agentforce Builder.
Vibes: a sentiment-analysis dashboard; Intelligent Context: the LLM's conversation memory.
explanation: Agentforce Vibes asiste en el desarrollo consciente de la gobernanza, mientras que Intelligent Context gestiona contenido no estructurado para grounding.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has built a custom retriever grounding AI responses with technical documentation. SL now requires that a summary field from the search index be included in the output to provide a brief overview of each retrieved document. What is the recommended course of action for SL?
options: Create a completely new custom retriever with an entirely revised configuration that incorporates the summary field, and delete the current retriever. Editing the existing retriever is not possible.

Edit the existing retriever version to add the summary field to the list of fields returned by the retriever, save the changes, and activate the new version so that prompt templates use the updated configuration.
Use only the default retriever, which will automatically include all available fields from the search index, including the summary field, without any need to create or manage custom retrievers.
explanation: Los recuperadores personalizados se pueden editar para añadir campos nuevos y activar la actualización, sin necesidad de crear uno nuevo.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has long, complex legal agreements. An Agentforce agent must be able to retrieve specific clauses that are often nested within larger sections. The standard chunking method is failing to capture the full context of these clauses. Which chunking strategy should an administrator use to preserve the structure of the documents?
options: Implement a smaller chunk size.
Implement a larger chunk size.
Implement a keyword-based chunking strategy.
explanation: Para mantener el contexto de cláusulas anidadas en documentos legales, es recomendable usar un tamaño de fragmento (chunk size) más grande.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is working declaratively on version 4 of a prompt template which is significantly different from the previous version 3. A bug is then identified in version 3 and requires a hotfix to be deployed to production immediately by another team. The team will deploy this change as a new version. What should the specialist do to ensure that their work on the latest version is not lost and does not conflict with the new version?
options: Create a new prompt template with the bug fix, update all references to the new version, and delete the old prompt template.
Save their work in version 4, and allow the template to be deployed with a new version 5 containing the fix.
Copy and paste version 4 into a backup file or version-control alternative, and allow the other team to overwrite the contents of version 4 with the bug-fixed version.
explanation: Prompt Builder guarda versiones de manera aditiva, por lo que el progreso en una versión no impide que otros equipos implementen correcciones en versiones nuevas.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has built a Service Agent for its hospitality brand grounded on a knowledge data library containing 200 FAQ articles covering reservations, amenities, and cancellation policies. The project team estimates that manually authoring test cases to achieve adequate knowledge coverage would take 3 weeks. A junior administrator proposes that Testing Center can significantly accelerate this process. Which step should an Agentforce Specialist take to generate a comprehensive initial test suite without manual authoring of individual test cases?
options: Upload test cases.
Generate test cases based on the knowledge available to the agent.
Generate test cases based on subagent (formerly known as a topic) and actions.
explanation: Testing Center permite generar automáticamente un conjunto de pruebas basado en el conocimiento disponible para el agente, reduciendo semanas de trabajo.

question: Universal Containers has deployed Agentforce to handle customer order tracking, returns, and loyalty support. The agent needs to balance conversational flexibility for customer inquiries with guaranteed execution of identity verification steps before accessing the account information. The development team is evaluating how to structure the agent's instruction pattern to meet both requirements. Which statement correctly describes hybrid reasoning in Agentforce Agent Script?
options: Hybrid reasoning uses multiple large language model (LLM) models simultaneously, with one model handling conversational responses and another model executing deterministic business logic through Flow integration.
Hybrid reasoning requires Canvas View for declarative instructions and Script View for procedural instructions, as each editor provides different capabilities for the respective instruction types.

Hybrid reasoning combines declarative natural language instructions that allow large language model (LLM) interpretation with procedural instructions using the '->' prefix that enforce guaranteed execution order.
explanation: El razonamiento híbrido en Agent Script permite combinar lenguaje natural flexible con instrucciones procedimentales (->) para pasos deterministas.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is trying to troubleshoot a reported issue from an end user and they do not see the session in the Processed Sessions tab of Agentforce Observability. What should the specialist take into consideration?
options: The agent has not yet been registered in the Observability app so no sessions are processed.
The session is queued to be processed and can be viewed on the Unprocessed Sessions tab.
Sessions are batched on a 24-hour rolling process and the logs must be checked again the next day.
explanation: Agentforce Observability procesa datos asíncronamente; si una sesión no aparece en 'Procesadas', probablemente sigue en cola ('Unprocessed Sessions').

question: During retrieval augmented generation (RAG) quality testing, an Agentforce Specialist notices that tabular information from a custom Data 360 Document Ingestion Pipeline is losing its context because the data is scattered across multiple separate chunks. What is the most appropriate approach to resolve this?
options: Change the search index's parser from the default to Docling.
Use an ensemble retriever to stitch multiple chunks back together dynamically.
Switch the search index configuration to use only keyword search scoring.
explanation: El analizador Docling entiende tablas y diseños complejos, previniendo que los datos tabulares pierdan su contexto durante la fragmentación.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is deploying a new customer service agent using Agent Script. The Agentforce Specialist needs to update conversational state, navigate between different subagent (formerly known as a topic), and hand off conversations to a human agent when necessary. To minimize technical debt, the Agentforce Specialist wants to implement these capabilities without building any custom backend code. Which statement correctly describes how the Agentforce Specialist can implement these specific requirements?
options: The Agentforce Specialist can use @utils.setVariables, @utils.transition, and @utils.escalate directly.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities directly, but @utils.escalate requires a custom Apex class to define the escalation queue.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities out of the box, but @utils.transition requires a flow to define the target subagent at runtime.
explanation: Agent Script posee utilidades nativas como @utils.setVariables y @utils.transition, permitiendo manejar el estado y la escalación sin código Apex.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has a Flex prompt template that has been used for the last 3 months to answer questions based on user input. Now, SL wants to give a PDF as a second input. What is the best approach for the Agentforce Specialist to meet this requirement?
options: Reindex in order to add a new resource to an existing template.
Add a Resource anytime by navigating to the Resources section and configuring inputs.
Discard the current Flex template and create a new one with a resource.
explanation: Las plantillas Flex permiten agregar nuevos recursos, como archivos PDF, en cualquier momento desde su configuración sin tener que recrearlas.

question: An Agentforce Specialist deployed a Service Agent to an Experience Cloud site and enabled Credential Based User Verification. The specialist notices that all Data Manipulation Language (DML) record updates are showing the "LastModifiedUser" as the authenticated Community User instead of the Agent User. What should the specialist explain to the business about the effect on audit fields?
options: Credential-Based User Verification has been enabled which in turn respects all of the sharing and field level security.
The Flow execution mode for the agent is set 'System Context Without Sharing'.
Token-Based User Verification has been enabled which in turn respects all of the sharing and field level security.
explanation: La verificación basada en credenciales hace que el agente actúe bajo el contexto del usuario autenticado, reflejándose en los campos de auditoría y seguridad.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is deploying two agents simultaneously: an internal Sales Productivity Agent for employees and a customer facing Service Agent on its Experience Cloud site. An Agentforce Specialist is configuring permissions and needs to understand the correct security context for each. Which statement accurately describes the execution model?
options: The customer-facing Service Agent inherits the security context of the Experience Cloud site's guest user profile by default, requiring guest profile object permissions to be configured for all actions the agent executes.

The internal Sales Productivity Agent executes actions using the authenticated Salesforce employee's own permissions, while the customer-facing Service Agent executes actions as a dedicated Einstein Service Agent User with its own permission set.

Both the internal Sales Productivity Agent and the customer-facing Service Agent execute actions as a dedicated Einstein Service Agent User with its own permission set that is configured as required for the agent.
explanation: Los agentes internos operan con los permisos del empleado autenticado, mientras que los de cara al cliente usan un perfil dedicado (Einstein Service Agent User).

question: Apex Logistics has built an AI-powered virtual assistant to help customers track shipments and resolve delivery exceptions. Before deploying it to their support portal, the quality assurance team needs a repeatable, data-driven method to verify the assistant's responses across hundreds of unique scenarios without manual effort. Which approach should they implement?
options: Deploy the assistant to a small group of beta customers, collect feedback on incorrect answers for two weeks, and then manually correct the underlying instructions.
Upload a batch test manifest in JSON Lines format, then execute the validation pipeline to generate automated pass/fail metrics for every test case.
Manually simulate conversations using the agent's playground interface and rely on senior QA analysts to approve each intent path individually.
explanation: La forma escalable y objetiva de probar masivamente es subir un archivo de validación por lotes en JSON Lines para obtener métricas automatizadas.

question: A financial services firm has built an AI agent using a low-code orchestration tool. The agent has a "Process Investment Withdrawal" action. According to company policy, withdrawals are allowed only if the client's Risk Profile is "Aggressive." Currently, the agent relies on its base instructions to check this field, but it sometimes hallucinates authorization and tries to execute the withdrawal for "Conservative" clients, causing transaction errors. How can the specialist enforce a deterministic control that prevents the agent from even seeing the withdrawal action unless the client meets the eligibility rule?
options: Add a conditional availability rule directly on the "Process Investment Withdrawal" action so that the action is hidden from the agent unless Risk_Profile__c = "Aggressive".
Rewrite the agent's system instructions to include a strict warning: "Never call withdrawal for Conservative clients" and hope the language model follows it.
Configure a keyword filter that automatically blocks the words "withdrawal" or "redeem" from appearing in the user's message if the client is not Aggressive.
explanation: Agregar una regla de disponibilidad condicional directamente en la acción garantiza de forma determinista que solo usuarios elegibles puedan ejecutarla.

question: A healthcare provider is building a custom agent that calls an Apex action to update patient medication lists. The action requires an input parameter that accepts multiple medication names (a list of text values). The specialist is defining the action's metadata in the agent's asset library. Which complex data type name should they use to correctly map a list of strings to the Apex parameter?
options: lightning__textType
apex__TextList
lightning__stringType
explanation: El tipo de dato estándar 'lightning__textType' es el correcto en los metadatos de Agentforce, incluso para colecciones como listas de texto en Apex.

question: A logistics company wants to upload several warehouse safety manuals (PDFs) to a new Agentforce Data Library. They plan to use advanced processing with Intelligent Context to optimize chunking and parsing based on document layout. How should they proceed to let the system first determine the optimal indexing configuration before processing the full document set?
options: Upload up to five PDFs, each no larger than 10 MB, so the system can analyze structure and recommend chunk size, overlap, and parsing strategy.
Manually enable "Intelligent Context" in the library settings before uploading any files.
Upload all PDFs (any size) at once; the system will automatically detect and apply optimal indexing as a background job.
explanation: Se debe subir primero una muestra pequeña (hasta 5 PDFs de máximo 10 MB) para que Intelligent Context recomiende la estrategia de indexación óptima.

question: A global retailer runs a customer help center powered by an Agentforce Service Agent. The legal team maintains a Salesforce Knowledge base of return policies, warranty terms, and regulatory disclosures. These articles are updated frequently by subject matter experts. The agent must always retrieve only the most current, published content and answer customer questions using semantic understanding. What is the simplest, most maintainable solution?
options: Build a custom Apex REST endpoint that queries the Knowledge object and returns matching articles via keyword search; call this endpoint from a sub-action every time the agent responds.
Connect an Agentforce Data Library directly to the Salesforce Knowledge base, filter for PublishStatus = 'Published', and let the agent use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with semantic search.
Configure a custom retriever in Einstein AI Studio that indexes Knowledge articles into a separate vector database and schedule a nightly sync to catch updates.
explanation: Conectar una biblioteca de datos a Salesforce Knowledge con un filtro PublishStatus es la solución ideal para asegurar que el agente siempre use contenido actual.

question: An airline's customer service team needs a Flex prompt template to generate post-call summaries for baggage issue cases. The summary must follow a strict four-part format: "Problem," "Actions Taken," "Resolution," and "Next Steps." If no next step exists, the summary must state "No further action needed." Which approach ensures the language model consistently produces this exact structure?
options: Use a prompt-triggered flow to parse the raw LLM output and then reformat it using Apex string manipulation.
Include explicit section headings and conditional phrasing instructions in the prompt's "Format" and "Constraints" sections.
Apply chain-of-thought reasoning with a step that first outlines the four headings, then fills content beneath each.
explanation: Usar explícitamente secciones en 'Format' y reglas condicionales en 'Constraints' (patrón RTCCF) obliga al modelo a generar exactamente la estructura deseada.

question: A large manufacturing company has deployed three specialized Employee Agents: Facilities Request, IT Helpdesk, and Benefits Inquiry. Employees often pick the wrong agent (e.g., asking the Benefits agent to unlock a laptop), leading to failed interactions and frustration. Leadership wants a single, unified entry point that automatically understands intent and routes to the correct specialized agent, without requiring employees to choose from a list. Which architecture should be implemented?
options: A single orchestrator agent that uses a Multi-Agent (SOMA) design to interpret user input and delegate to the appropriate specialized agent dynamically.
A validation rule on the Agent Session object that blocks mismatched requests and prompts the user to reselect the correct agent.
A standalone Multi-Agent system where each agent includes a first message asking the user to confirm their department before proceeding.
explanation: Una arquitectura Multi-Agent (SOMA) usa un agente orquestador principal que delega dinámicamente cada consulta al agente especializado correcto.

question: A retail chain wants to ground an Agentforce agent with real-time inventory data stored in an external warehouse management system. They cannot duplicate the data into Data 360 due to storage costs and the need for millisecond-accurate stock levels. Which Data 360 capability allows virtual, real-time access to external structured data without ingestion?
options: Zero Copy data federation
Scheduled data streams with incremental refresh
Semantic index on external content
explanation: Zero Copy Data Federation permite realizar consultas en tiempo real a almacenes de datos externos sin necesidad de duplicar ni persistir la información.

question: In the context of retrieval-augmented generation, what is the primary purpose of converting a text chunk into a vector embedding?
options: To reduce the storage footprint of the original document by compressing it into a smaller numeric form.
To represent the chunk's semantic meaning as a set of numbers, enabling similarity searches based on conceptual closeness rather than exact keywords.
To encrypt the chunk so that it can be stored securely in a vector database without exposing plain text.
explanation: La vectorización convierte texto en representaciones numéricas, posibilitando búsquedas de similitud basadas en el significado semántico en vez de palabras clave.

question: A support manager needs to build a prompt in Prompt Builder that generates a post-call resolution note. The note must: Summarize the customer's issue, troubleshooting steps, and final resolution. Be at most three sentences. Use non-technical language. If no resolution was reached, explicitly state "Escalated to tier 2." Which combination of prompt constructs directly addresses all these requirements?
options: Role, Task, Format, and Output Validator
Task, Context, Constraints, and Format
Context, LLM Temperature, Token Limit, and Format
explanation: El patrón RTCCF (Task, Context, Constraints, Format) guía completamente al modelo sobre qué generar, qué reglas cumplir y cómo estructurar el resultado.

question: A national utility company's customer agent has been running for six weeks. The observability dashboard shows the "Billing Dispute" intent cluster has low quality, with the reason "ambiguous subagent match." Session traces confirm the planner routes billing disputes to the "Payment Arrangement" subagent on most turns. What is the most effective solution?
options: Reduce the number of subagents from 10 to 4 by merging billing and payment intents into a single subagent.
Rewrite the classification descriptions of the two overlapping subagents to eliminate semantic confusion and create clear boundaries.
Add a system instruction that says "Never send billing disputes to payment arrangement subagent" and place it in every subagent's prompt.
explanation: Reescribir las descripciones de clasificación de los subagentes para que sean mutuamente excluyentes previene la confusión semántica y soluciona el mal enrutamiento.

question: A medical lab must ensure its support agent always provides the most current version of testing procedure documents. Outdated content could lead to incorrect diagnoses. What should the specialist recommend?
options: Connect a knowledge-based data library to Salesforce Knowledge, which automatically retrieves only the published version of each article using native version control.
Store all procedure files in a file-based data library and manually delete old versions each time a new one is uploaded.
Add a "valid until" date field to each document and instruct the agent in its system prompt to ignore documents past that date.
explanation: Una biblioteca basada en Knowledge usa el control de versiones nativo para que el agente recupere invariablemente las políticas en su versión publicada actual.

question: A support team is building an Omni-Flow to route incoming chat messages from a retail website to live agents after the automated agent cannot resolve the issue. Which Omni-Flow element should they use to assign the conversation to an available agent based on skills and capacity?
options: Route Work
Allocate to Agent
Send to Queue
explanation: En Omni-Channel Flow, la acción 'Route Work' es la responsable de evaluar habilidades y capacidad disponible antes de asignar la conversación a un agente.

question: An auto parts retailer has a knowledge base with articles categorized by vehicle type (Car, Truck, Motorcycle). They want the agent to retrieve only Car articles. What does enabling "Filter by Knowledge Data Categories" do in a knowledge-based data library?
options: It adds the selected category names as metadata tags to each article to improve search ranking.
It limits the indexing process to include only articles assigned to the selected categories, excluding all others from retrieval.
It creates separate vector indexes for each category and searches them in parallel.
explanation: Filtrar por categoría de datos restringe desde la indexación los artículos admitidos, de modo que el contenido fuera de esa categoría no pueda ser recuperado.

question: A travel agency wants to route incoming Facebook Messenger messages to an automated agent that can handle flight changes, hotel bookings, and cancellation requests. Which destination is a valid Omni-Channel routing option for a messaging channel?
options: External chatbot via custom API
Agentforce Service Agent
Legacy Einstein Bot
explanation: Agentforce Service Agent es un destino de enrutamiento oficial y nativo dentro de Omni-Channel para procesar interacciones desde canales de mensajería.

question: A music streaming service deployed a Service Agent handling playlist recovery, account cancellation, and audio quality settings. After updating the Account Cancellation subagent instructions to include a retention offer flow, some cancellation questions started routing to the Playlist Recovery subagent. The team needs to diagnose the regression before full deployment. Which approach is most systematic and objective?
options: Run the stored test suite in Testing Center against the modified agent, review Subagent Pass % metrics to identify regressions, then add test cases for the retention flow.
Ask three support agents to manually test 20 conversation paths each and report misrouting.
Deploy to 5% of production users and monitor the misrouting rate in the observability dashboard for two days.
explanation: Testing Center ejecuta pruebas programáticas e identifica regresiones objetivamente mostrando reducciones claras en el porcentaje de aprobación por subagente.

question: An online pet supply store is building an agent to capture a customer's preferred delivery date during a conversation. The specialist declares a variable in Agent Script as delivery_date: string = "" (without the mutable keyword). Later, the agent tries to update it using @utils.setVariables. What happens at runtime?
options: The variable is automatically mutable because it is a string; the update succeeds.
The variable remains read-only; the update attempt has no effect because mutable was omitted.
The declaration causes a syntax error and the agent fails to publish.
explanation: Las variables en Agent Script son de solo lectura; sin la palabra clave 'mutable', un intento de actualizar su valor en tiempo de ejecución no tendrá efecto.

question: A credit union's agent frequently routes "loan application status" requests to the "credit card application" subagent. This misrouting has increased average handling time. The manager needs a quick solution that preserves the agent's ability to handle complex, branching conversations. What should the specialist do?
options: Add a deterministic routing hint to the loan status subagent's classification description, such as "only for loan status, not credit cards," to guide the planner without rigid rules.
Merge the two subagents into one to eliminate the routing decision entirely.
Insert a system instruction that says "Never send loan status questions to credit card subagent" at the top of the agent's configuration.
explanation: Agregar descripciones con sugerencias deterministas en la clasificación del subagente soluciona el enrutamiento incorrecto sin mermar la flexibilidad del modelo.

question: A logistics firm is ingesting large shipping contract PDFs into an agent's data library. They need to understand document processing to optimize retrieval. What is a key characteristic of the chunking process?
options: Chunking splits large documents into smaller, indexable passages, each vectorized for semantic matching to user queries.
Chunking compresses each document into a single vector that represents the entire file's average meaning.
Chunking sends the first 500 characters of each document to the LLM and discards the rest to save tokens.
explanation: El proceso de chunking fragmenta los documentos extensos en partes más pequeñas indexables, permitiendo recuperar información detallada y relevante.

question: A real estate investment firm is creating a prompt template for an agent that needs to reference property inspection records related to an account. The specialist wants to include fields from the Inspections__r related list on the Account object. What is the correct procedure in Prompt Builder?
options: Select the Inspections related list from the Account object, then use the field picker to choose specific merge fields from that list to include in the prompt.
Write an Apex method that queries the inspection records and returns JSON, then reference that method in the prompt.
Hard-code the inspection field names as literal text in the prompt and rely on the LLM to infer the relationship.
explanation: Prompt Builder permite agregar declarativamente listas relacionadas como Inspecciones y seleccionar campos de combinación sin tener que escribir código Apex.

question: A logistics company is building an agent to handle delivery address changes. The agent must first validate the customer's order number against an external ERP system, and only after successful validation should it call an existing Apex action that updates the address. The validation step is already configured as a separate action. Which implementation approach should the specialist recommend?
options: Add a new instruction to the agent's global system prompt saying "after validation, call the address update action" and rely on the LLM to sequence correctly.
Create a separate subagent for address updates, pass the validation result as a session variable, and let the second subagent's instructions check the variable before proceeding.
Within the same action flow that performs validation, add a deterministic conditional step that only invokes the address update Apex action if the validation response contains a success flag.
explanation: Implementar un paso condicional determinista asegura que la acción crítica de actualizar solo se invoque tras superar con éxito la etapa de validación.

question: A hospital network uses Agentforce for patient appointment scheduling. It also runs a separate AI system from a different vendor for managing operating room inventory. The hospital wants the Agentforce scheduler to autonomously request supply checks from the inventory system when scheduling surgeries. Which open standard protocol is specifically designed for this cross-vendor agent collaboration?
options: Inter-Agent Messaging Protocol (IMP)
Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol
Cross-Platform Agent Bridge (CPAB)
explanation: El Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol es un estándar abierto diseñado para que agentes autónomos de diferentes proveedores se descubran y colaboren de forma segura.

question: Before deploying a RAG-based agent to answer employee HR policy questions, a specialist wants to test whether a custom retriever returns the most relevant sections of HR documents for sample queries, without writing any code. Which tool should they use?
options: Retriever Playground
HR Document Tester
Retrieval Quality Console
explanation: Retriever Playground es una herramienta sin código idónea para probar consultas y revisar los fragmentos resultantes junto a sus puntajes de relevancia.

question: In a knowledge-based data library connected to a Salesforce Knowledge base, what is the primary functional difference between the fields labeled "searchable metadata" and "content body"?
options: Searchable metadata fields help the retriever locate the correct article via concise keywords, while the content body provides the detailed text that grounds the AI's response.
Searchable metadata fields store the full article text for retrieval, while the content body contains a short summary for preview.
Searchable metadata fields are used only for article categorization, while the content body is used only for relevance scoring.
explanation: Los metadatos indexables ayudan a localizar el artículo rápidamente, mientras que el cuerpo del contenido provee el texto rico usado para fundamentar a la IA.

question: A specialist creates a new Field Generation prompt template for the Lead object, targeting a custom field Lead_Score_AI__c. After saving, testing, and activating the template, they open a Lead record and see that Lead_Score_AI__c behaves like a normal editable field without the Sparkle icon. What critical step did they miss?
options: They forgot to assign the "Field Generation User" permission set to their user.
They forgot to edit the Lead record page in Lightning App Builder and associate the custom field with the prompt template.
They forgot to run the "Refresh Field Generation Cache" scheduled job.
explanation: Después de activar una prompt template de generación de campos, se debe asociar manualmente el campo en el Lightning App Builder para ver el icono Sparkle.

question: A specialist is troubleshooting an agent that makes up fake product SKUs in its responses. The agent uses an action with a prompt template that includes a knowledge retriever. What is the most appropriate first step to diagnose the root cause?
options: Check the retrieved chunks in the resolved prompt output to see if the LLM is generating SKUs not present in the grounding data.
Add a system instruction that says "NEVER invent SKUs" in bold and re-test.
Verify that the subagent's classification description has a high confidence threshold.
explanation: Revisar los fragmentos recuperados en el prompt resuelto permite confirmar si las alucinaciones se deben a falta de contexto o a inventos del modelo.

question: A specialist tests an agent connected to a data library. The agent retrieves the correct information but presents it as raw XML markup instead of natural, grammatically correct sentences. Which quality evaluation metric would score poorly in this scenario?
options: Coherence
Completeness
Conciseness
explanation: La coherencia mide si la respuesta fluye naturalmente con una estructura y gramática lógicas; una salida de texto en bruto fallaría estrepitosamente aquí.

question: A university needs a service agent to ground its answers using both student handbook PDFs (file-based) and a knowledge base of course catalog articles. Which type of retriever should the specialist configure?
options: Multi-source retriever
Ensemble retriever
Hybrid retriever
explanation: Un Ensemble Retriever combina inteligentemente resultados provenientes de múltiples fuentes de índices (como archivos y knowledge base) en una sola consulta.

question: A specialty coffee retailer builds an agent in a developer sandbox to handle loyalty point inquiries. The agent uses a custom Apex action that calls an external rewards API. After deploying all components (agent, Apex class, permission sets) to production using a metadata deployment, the agent fails to respond to any test messages. The Apex action is active and the API endpoint is reachable. What is the most likely missing step?
options: The agent's "Production Ready" checkbox must be selected in the sandbox before deployment, otherwise the agent deploys in a suspended state.
The specialist must manually activate the agent in the production environment because deployment does not preserve the active/inactive status.
The external API requires a different authentication certificate in production; the specialist must re-upload the certificate and update the named credential.
explanation: El estado activo de un agente no se traslada en implementaciones por metadatos, por lo que el especialista debe activarlo manualmente en el entorno de producción.

question: A publishing company builds an agent to answer royalty payment questions. The agent retrieves data from two Data 360 indexes: one connected to internal contract files and another connected to an external sales reporting system. During testing, the agent gives inconsistent answers about royalty rates. The specialist needs to identify whether each piece of information came from the internal contracts or the external sales system. What is the most direct way to trace the source?
options: Examine the "Index Source" column in the Data 360 data space settings, which logs every retrieval event with source attribution.
Run the same query in the Retriever Playground and inspect the data_source_name field returned with each chunk to see which index it belongs to.
Add a post-processing step in the prompt template that asks the LLM to append "[INTERNAL]" or "[EXTERNAL]" to every sentence based on its own judgment.
explanation: Consultar a través de Retriever Playground muestra el origen o metadata (como data_source_name) de cada fragmento, permitiendo rastrear su índice respectivo.

question: A telecom company's customer agent keeps sending "billing dispute" conversations to the "plan upgrade" subagent, even when users explicitly mention overcharges or incorrect fees. The specialist has added guard conditions but the problem continues. What is the most likely root cause?
options: The global system instructions contain conflicting directives that prioritize plan upgrades over billing disputes.
The "plan upgrade" subagent has a higher numerical priority setting than the billing dispute subagent.
The classification descriptions for the two subagents have significant semantic overlap, confusing the planner.
explanation: El enrutamiento incorrecto persistente, a pesar de las condiciones de protección, indica una superposición semántica en las descripciones de clasificación. El planificador usa coincidencia semántica, no un sistema de prioridad numérica.

question: An e-commerce agent has an "Apply Discount" action restricted by the guard `available when @user.verified = true`. During a single conversation turn, the LLM successfully sets `verified = true` using `@utils.setVariables`, but then fails to call the "Apply Discount" action in the same turn. Why does this happen?
options: The action's availability condition re-evaluates instantly after each variable change, but the LLM's reasoning cycle cannot keep up within the same turn.
The guard condition is evaluated once at the start of the reasoning cycle; variable changes made during the turn do not trigger re-evaluation until the next turn.
The LLM must explicitly request a "refresh availability" call before the action becomes visible, which the specialist forgot to include.
explanation: El ciclo de razonamiento reevalúa las condiciones `available when` múltiples veces dentro de un mismo turno del usuario. Aunque la evidencia documentada apoya esto, la opción marcada como correcta asume lo contrario por falta de una mejor alternativa.

question: A mortgage lender's agent must perform credit checks and income verification in a strict sequence to comply with regulations. The agent also needs to respond flexibly to borrower questions. Which statement correctly differentiates declarative and procedural instructions in Agent Script's hybrid reasoning model?
options: Declarative instructions guarantee execution order using -> prefixes, while procedural instructions allow the LLM to reorder steps for natural conversation.
Declarative instructions are ignored in production environments; only procedural instructions enforce business rules.
Declarative instructions give the LLM conversational flexibility, while procedural instructions (using ->, run, if) enforce a guaranteed execution sequence.
explanation: El modelo híbrido combina instrucciones declarativas (conversacionales) con instrucciones de procedimiento (`->`, `run`, `if`) que garantizan una secuencia estricta. Esto es ideal para procesos obligatorios como verificaciones de crédito y cumplimiento.

question: A property management company's agent must check if a maintenance request is within warranty before dispatching a technician. The company wants to keep the conversation natural for tenants but ensure the warranty check always happens first. What should the specialist do?
options: Use procedural instructions in Agent Script to enforce the warranty check step before any technician dispatch action.
Move the warranty check logic into a separate agent and route all maintenance requests through that agent first.
Add a natural language instruction at the top of the subagent prompt saying "Always check warranty before dispatching."
explanation: Para garantizar que una verificación obligatoria ocurra antes de otra acción, deben usarse instrucciones de procedimiento (`->`). Estas se ejecutan de manera determinista, evitando que el LLM las omita.

question: A retail chain needs to create Data 360 reports to analyze how customers interact with their shopping assistant. Which data lake object represents a complete container that captures all turns and messages from the start to the end of a single user-agent conversation?
options: AIAgentConversation
AIAgentSession
AIAgentTurn
explanation: En el modelo de datos de rastreo, `AIAgentSession` representa el contenedor completo a nivel de sesión. Los detalles de cada mensaje se guardan en objetos relacionados, no en uno llamado `AIAgentTurn`.

question: A nonprofit organization uses only no-code tools. They have many small donors who give sporadically. They want to prepare their fundraising team for calls by: summarizing past donations, showing events the donor attended, and recapping email conversations. Which approach should the specialist recommend?
options: Export all donor data to a CSV and manually create summaries in a document.
Use a prompt template grounded on CRM and Data 360 data with standard foundation models.
Fine-tune a large language model on the donor data to generate custom summaries.
explanation: Una plantilla de prompt basada en datos de CRM y Data Cloud permite resumir interacciones previas sin código adicional. Es una solución nativa y escalable que evita el ajuste fino manual o exportaciones.

question: A logistics company built a custom Apex action that an employee agent calls to fetch real-time shipment tracking from an external carrier API. The Apex method uses UserInfo.getSessionId() to authenticate the callout. The callout works when tested in the UI but fails silently when the agent triggers it. What is the best practice fix?
options: Add `with sharing` to the Apex class to ensure the agent's session has proper permissions.
Replace the session ID retrieval with a Named Credential configured for the external API.
Store the session ID in a custom label and reference it in the Apex callout.
explanation: Las credenciales nombradas (Named Credentials) son la mejor práctica para autenticar llamadas externas en Salesforce. Gestionan la seguridad de forma confiable, a diferencia de `UserInfo.getSessionId()`.

question: A software company launches a partner portal on Experience Cloud. Partners need an agent that can answer technical product questions from the knowledge base and also create new opportunity records for potential deals they identify. The agent must only be accessible to logged-in partner users. Which agent type meets these requirements?
options: Service Agent
Sales Agent
Partner Agent
explanation: Para usuarios externos autenticados en Experience Cloud (como partners), el tipo correcto es Service Agent. Se puede extender con Custom Actions para tareas como crear Leads u Oportunidades.

question: A bank's service agent can access sensitive account transaction data only after the customer completes voice biometric verification. The specialist needs a deterministic control that prevents the LLM from bypassing verification to run the "Show Transactions" action. What should they configure?
options: Apply an availability filter (available when) on the "Show Transactions" action so it is hidden from the planner until a verification variable becomes true.
Add a system instruction that says "Never show transactions without verification" and place it in every subagent.
Store the transaction data in an encrypted field and only decrypt it after the LLM requests verification.
explanation: Un filtro `available when` oculta completamente la acción al planificador hasta que se cumpla la condición. Esto garantiza de forma determinista que no se ejecute sin la verificación previa.

question: Apex Aeronautics built a prompt template in their sandbox that uses a custom language model they trained on maintenance logs. When deploying the change set to production, they get an error related to the model. What should they check?
options: The custom model must be registered again in production using the exact same API name as in the sandbox.
The prompt template must be marked as "Production Ready" in the sandbox before deployment.
The production org requires a separate license for custom models that the sandbox does not need.
explanation: Las plantillas de prompt hacen referencia al nombre de la API del modelo BYOLLM. Para un despliegue exitoso, el modelo debe existir en la organización de destino con exactamente el mismo nombre.

question: MediCare Plus needs a prompt to extract prescription name and dosage from patient emails. Which practice will produce the most consistent and accurate extraction?
options: Use a high creativity setting (temperature 0.9) to allow the model to infer missing dosage information.
Provide two example emails with the correct extracted fields and set the temperature close to zero.
Ask the model to first list all medications it sees, then select the primary prescription.
explanation: Para la extracción determinista de datos estructurados, la mejor práctica es usar ejemplos detallados (few-shot) y una temperatura cercana a cero. Esto minimiza las alucinaciones y garantiza consistencia.

question: GreenLeaf Energy has an agent that calculates solar panel warranty discounts based on installation date. The agent must quote the exact discount amount and reuse the same number when generating the final confirmation. How should they ensure deterministic storage and reuse?
options: Store the discount in a context variable via a flow action and have the agent reference that variable in all responses.
Instruct the agent in its system prompt to "remember this discount amount for later.”
Recalculate the discount each time by re-executing the same formula from the agent's memory.
explanation: Almacenar un valor calculado en una variable de sesión (`@utils.setVariables`) asegura su reutilización determinista. Depender del LLM para recordar o recalcular introduce riesgo de variabilidad.

question: Global Transport wants its agent to answer shipment tracking questions using actual order data from their Salesforce CRM. Which Einstein Trust Layer component injects this trusted business data directly into the prompt to improve accuracy?
options: Prompt Defense
Dynamic Grounding
Output Caching
explanation: Dynamic Grounding inyecta datos relevantes de CRM y Data Cloud en las plantillas de prompt en tiempo de ejecución. Esto garantiza que las respuestas se basen en datos reales y respeten la seguridad a nivel de campo.

question: City Library System is creating a prompt template on the Patron object and wants to include open tasks and events. However, the Activities related list does not appear in the merge field picker. Why?
options: The Activities object is only available if the "Activity Tracking" permission is enabled for the user.
The Activities related list is polymorphic (can link to multiple object types) and is not supported for merge fields in Prompt Builder.
Merge fields only work on master-detail relationships; Activities use a lookup relationship.
explanation: La lista relacionada de Actividades es polimórfica y Prompt Builder no admite campos de combinación para estas relaciones. Esta es una limitación estructural, no un problema de permisos.

question: HealthFirst Clinic has a Private organization-wide default on the Patient Record object. An agent running a flow to retrieve patient records returns nothing even though records exist and the flow is correct. Which fix follows the principle of least privilege?
options: Grant the agent's user profile read access to Patient Record and create sharing rules for only the necessary records.
Change the OWD on Patient Record to Public Read Only so the agent can see all patient records.
Set the flow to run in System Mode without sharing to bypass all security.
explanation: El principio de privilegio mínimo indica otorgar acceso explícito al perfil del agente junto con reglas de uso compartido específicas. Esto evita sobreexponer datos al cambiar el acceso general de la organización.

question: Digital Harbor needs agents for three tasks: scoring inbound marketing leads, replying to customer support tickets, and helping employees with VPN access. Which agent type matches each role?
options: Lead Scoring Agent for marketing, Service Agent for customer tickets, Employee Agent for internal VPN help.
One unified agent with three subagents configured to switch based on keywords.
Employee Agent for lead scoring, Sales Agent for support tickets, Service Agent for VPN help.
explanation: Se debe usar un agente especializado para cada dominio: Service Agent para clientes, Employee Agent para necesidades internas y un agente específico (SDR Agent) para marketing. Combinarlos en uno solo genera errores de enrutamiento.

question: Prestige Hotels wants its agent to use a warm, welcoming tone and always end responses with a signature line. These requirements go beyond simple correctness. How should they configure Testing Center to evaluate this?
options: Enable the standard Completeness metric to ensure all required elements are present.
Create a custom LLM judge evaluation with criteria for tone (warm, welcoming) and format (signature line present).
Use the built-in Coherence metric to check for grammatical errors.
explanation: Los requisitos específicos de marca, como el tono o firmas personalizadas, requieren una evaluación personalizada con el LLM como juez. Las métricas estándar de integridad o coherencia no evalúan criterios cualitativos.

question: Urban Bike Rentals wants users to click a button on a Rental Order record to generate a "Damage Report" description. Users must preview, regenerate, or edit the text before saving. They can only use declarative tools. Which prompt template type should they use?
options: Field Generation
Flex
Auto Summary
explanation: Las plantillas de tipo Field Generation están diseñadas para autocompletar campos en registros. Ofrecen una interfaz nativa que permite previsualizar, regenerar y editar el texto antes de guardarlo.

question: SecureEdge Financial requires that developers only use language models from a pre-approved list. How can an administrator enforce this across the entire organization?
options: In Einstein Setup, under Model Provider settings, enable only the approved models and disable all others.
Create a validation rule on the Prompt Template object that blocks templates using unapproved model names.
Assign a permission set to all developers that revokes access to unapproved models.
explanation: La disponibilidad de modelos se controla centralmente desde la sección de Proveedores de Modelos en la Configuración de Einstein. Esto asegura que solo los modelos aprobados se utilicen en toda la organización.

question: Northwind Logistics observes that its agent often misroutes "freight damage" claims to the "delivery delay" subagent. The manager needs to identify how frequently this happens across thousands of daily conversations without reading each transcript. Which tool should they use?
options: Agent Optimization in Agentforce Studio, which automatically clusters user intents from production sessions and highlights subagent mismatches.
Enable Session Tracing and manually search for keywords like "damage" in the logs.
Run a batch test in Testing Center with sample damage claims to see classification results.
explanation: Agent Optimization agrupa intenciones y analiza sesiones en producción para identificar patrones de enrutamiento incorrecto a gran escala. Es la herramienta ideal para monitoreo continuo, superando la búsqueda manual.

question: Nexa Motors operates separate Salesforce orgs for manufacturing and dealership management. A customer validation agent in the manufacturing org must pass a verified vehicle identification number (VIN) to a downstream warranty agent in the dealership org within the same conversation. The VIN must remain unreadable and unmodifiable by the language model. What should the architect implement?
options: Encrypt the VIN using a platform encryption key and store it in a custom label that both agents can reference.
Store the verified VIN in a session-scoped variable that persists across agent boundaries and is excluded from the LLM's context.
Transmit the VIN via an outbound REST call to a temporary holding table, then have the downstream agent query the table.
explanation: A nivel de plataforma, no existe un mecanismo nativo simple para cruzar variables de sesión entre dos organizaciones distintas. La colaboración entre agentes de diferentes entornos se manejaría idealmente mediante el protocolo Agent-to-Agent (A2A).

question: CityMed Healthcare uses an external AI agent for patient intake scheduling and an Agentforce agent for prescription renewals. They want the scheduling agent to automatically alert the prescription agent when a patient completes an intake form. Which standard protocol is specifically built for this kind of cross-platform agent collaboration?
options: gRPC with protocol buffers
Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol
Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP)
explanation: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) es el protocolo estándar diseñado para el descubrimiento y delegación de tareas entre agentes de IA en distintas plataformas. Es ideal para la coordinación automatizada entre sistemas.

question: Verdant Finance is creating prompt templates using Salesforce's standard foundation models. Leadership requires that all generated responses use a respectful, reassuring, and transparent tone. The company does not allow custom models. Which prompt engineering method in Prompt Builder most effectively establishes this tone?
options: Add a negative instruction such as "Never use aggressive or dismissive language" to each prompt.
Embed a persona directive like "You are a patient, transparent financial advisor speaking to a concerned client."
Attach a pull-down menu that asks the model to pick a tone level (1–5) before generating the answer.
explanation: Asignar una directiva de persona o rol es la técnica más efectiva para definir el tono de un modelo preentrenado. Esto proporciona un marco de comportamiento coherente sin requerir ajustes finos.

question: BrightStar Energy enabled Einstein Generative AI in Setup. A specialist wants to build a new prompt template but cannot locate Prompt Builder anywhere in the Setup menu. What is the most probable cause?
options: The "Prompt Template Author" feature license has not been assigned to the org.
The user's profile lacks the "Manage Prompt Templates" system permission.
The Data 360 data space has not been configured for the org.
explanation: El acceso a Prompt Builder requiere que el perfil del usuario tenga el permiso de sistema 'Manage Prompt Templates'. Sin este permiso, la opción no aparecerá en el menú de configuración.

question: Harbor Freight needs its agent to verify a shipment's hazardous material status before processing a release action. The conversation must stay natural and unscripted, but the verification step must never be skipped. What should the specialist configure?
options: Place the verification logic in a flow, make the release action invisible until a verification variable is true, and set that variable only after the flow runs.
Add a system instruction that says "Always verify hazmat status before releasing shipment" and rely on the LLM to comply.
Create a separate agent for hazardous materials and force the user to transfer to it before any release action.
explanation: Usar un flujo determinista para establecer una variable y controlar la disponibilidad de la acción con `available when` garantiza que nunca se omita la verificación. Esto mantiene el resto de la conversación fluida y natural.

question: DataShield Corp has a security policy that only language models with SOC 2 compliance may be used across the org's AI features. Where should the specialist enforce this restriction so that non-compliant models cannot be selected by anyone building prompt templates or agents?
options: In Einstein Setup, under the Model Provider section, restrict which models are approved/enabled for use in the org.
In each individual prompt template, manually avoid selecting non-compliant models.
In the Testing Center, configure an evaluation rule that fails any test run using a non-compliant model.
explanation: Las restricciones de uso de modelos deben aplicarse de forma centralizada en la configuración de Proveedores de Modelos. Esto impide desde la raíz que los constructores seleccionen modelos no aprobados en toda la organización.

question: Academy of Arts wants students to be able to ask its enrollment agent to check available class slots and enroll themselves directly through conversation, with the enrollment logic reusing validation rules that already exist as a declarative automation in the org. What should the specialist use as the custom action?
options: An Auto-launched Flow that performs the validation and enrollment, exposed to the agent as a custom action.
An Apex trigger on the Enrollment object, since triggers can be called directly by agent actions.
A Visualforce page embedded in the agent's response.
explanation: Los flujos autoiniciados (Auto-launched Flows) son la herramienta estándar para exponer lógicas declarativas existentes como acciones de agente. Permiten reutilizar validaciones sin necesidad de código adicional.

question: GreenStay Hotels' agent needs to send a booking confirmation email immediately after successfully processing a reservation, as part of the same deterministic sequence, without waiting for the LLM to decide whether to do it. Which Agent Script keyword lets the specialist chain that action to run right after the reservation action completes?
options: `run`
`mutable`
`available when`
explanation: En Agent Script, la palabra clave `run` asegura la ejecución inmediata y determinista de una acción tras otra. Esto elimina la discreción del LLM, garantizando la secuencia correcta.

question: Coastline Credit Union needs a weekly dashboard for its leadership team showing agent deflection and escalation trends over time, without building custom reports from scratch. Which native Agentforce Observability capability should the specialist point them to?
options: Agent Analytics, which provides prebuilt, Tableau-powered dashboards covering deflection, abandonment, escalations, and volume trends.
The raw Session Tracing Data Model objects, queried manually via SOQL each week.
Testing Center pass/fail results, exported to a spreadsheet weekly.
explanation: Agent Analytics proporciona paneles preconstruidos impulsados por Tableau que muestran tendencias de desvío, abandono y escalamiento. Es la solución nativa ideal para reportes ejecutivos.

question: NovaTech Logistics wants to empower its support representatives to check real-time shipment tracking details using plain conversational language. A pre-built autolaunched flow already exists to pull data from SAP, the company's system of record for logistics operations. How should an Agentforce Specialist best extend this capability using conversational AI?
options: Set up a Sales Coach prompt template in Prompt Builder to surface shipment data contextually.
Enable the "Logistics Query" standard action inside Agentforce Builder to connect directly to SAP.
Build a custom agent action that invokes the existing autolaunched flow.
explanation: Construir una acción de agente personalizada que invoque un flujo autoiniciado existente es la práctica estándar. Esto reutiliza integraciones declarativas sin necesidad de duplicar lógica.

question: An Agentforce Specialist at SunVista Hotels is tasked with building an AI agent to handle guest dissatisfaction cases automatically. The agent should be capable of offering room upgrades, dining credits, and complimentary amenities. When a guest experiences a severe service failure — such as an overbooking — the agent must escalate the case to a live representative. Per Salesforce best practices, which agent type should the specialist deploy?
options: Agentforce with a Sales prompt template.
Employee Agent with a structured topic configuration.
Service Agent with a Flex prompt template.
explanation: El Service Agent está diseñado específicamente para atención al cliente y puede manejar quejas o escalamientos. Combinado con un Flex template, permite generar respuestas de compensación dinámicas y personalizadas.

question: MediCore Clinics is refining its patient intake agent to meet strict regulatory requirements. The compliance officer has mandated that agents must confirm a patient's identity before any downstream action — such as booking a lab test — can be triggered. The verification step must be enforced deterministically, blocking all subsequent actions until it is satisfied. What approach should the Agentforce Specialist recommend using standard configuration methods?
options: Write a custom Lightning Web Component that monitors agent session state and hides scheduling buttons until verification is confirmed.
Apply dynamic template expressions inside the scheduling action description to display a verification warning when the patient is unverified.
Update a mutable session variable for verification status using `@utils.setVariables`, then control the lab booking action visibility with an `available when` condition.
explanation: Se debe usar `@utils.setVariables` para guardar el estado y luego condicionar la acción con `available when`. Este enfoque determinista oculta la acción al LLM hasta que se complete la verificación.

question: BrightPath Education is building a custom agent and has developed an Apex action that accepts a collection of course names as an input parameter (a list of strings). The Agentforce Specialist needs to correctly define this input in the action's metadata so the reasoning engine can pass the list accurately. Which `complex_data_type_name` should be specified for this input?
options: `apex__String`
`lightning__textType`
`apex__StringList`
explanation: En la configuración de metadatos de Agentforce, una lista de cadenas de texto de Apex se mapea al tipo `lightning__textType`. Opciones como `apex__StringList` no son válidas en este esquema.

question: Momentum Retail created a prompt template in its sandbox environment and saved multiple iterations during the review process. The team is now ready to promote the template to production. What should the team keep in mind regarding version handling during deployment?
options: Only the currently active version of the prompt template is packaged for deployment; all draft versions are excluded automatically.
All versions of the prompt template that exist in the source org are included when the template is deployed to the target org.
The deployment process merges conflicting versions between source and target org, keeping the most recently modified one.
explanation: Al desplegar un componente de metadatos como una plantilla de prompt, todas sus versiones contenidas viajan juntas en el archivo XML. Sin embargo, su activación posterior dependerá del entorno destino.

question: The concierge team at Meridian Resorts wants to automatically generate a personalized activity recommendation summary for each guest, based on preferences stored in their Contact record. The summary should appear directly on the Contact record page and nowhere else. Which Salesforce AI capability is most appropriate?
options: Agentforce Builder.
Einstein Prediction Builder.
Prompt Builder.
explanation: Prompt Builder, a través de plantillas tipo Field Generation o Record Summary, permite generar texto contextualizado a mostrarse directamente en un registro. Es la capacidad de IA ideal para resumir recomendaciones en la interfaz.

question: Alpine Ventures needs to generate personalized partnership outreach emails. The prompt template must incorporate data from three sources: Account history records, upcoming industry events in the prospect's region, and writing style guidelines. How should the Agentforce Specialist structure the template to ground the output on all three data sources?
options: Use a Record Summary template and link each data source as a separate related list on the Account page.
Build a prompt-initiated flow that fetches all three data sources and passes them to a standard email template.
Create a Flex template that accepts the Account record, event records, and style guide as direct inputs.
explanation: Las plantillas Flex de Prompt Builder son las más versátiles, permitiendo procesar múltiples fuentes de datos estructurados simultáneamente. Esto es ideal para fundamentar respuestas combinando diversos registros.

question: DataSphere Analytics has ingested and vectorized unstructured client feedback documents into a Data Cloud search index. An Agentforce Specialist needs to wire this indexed data into a prompt template so the most relevant feedback passages are dynamically surfaced during AI-generated responses. What is the correct configuration approach?
options: Build a Flex template pointing to a Data Lake Object (DLO) to access the raw ingested feedback files.
Build a Flex template that references a retriever connected to the vector search index.
Build a Flex template that queries a Data Model Object (DMO) to pull structured feedback records.
explanation: Para integrar datos no estructurados vectorizados en un Flex template, se debe referenciar un 'retriever'. Este componente consulta el índice vectorial y devuelve los fragmentos más relevantes.

question: Which of the following business scenarios represents the strongest use case for Prompt Builder?
options: Automatically scoring inbound leads based on demographic and behavioral signals.
Routing incoming service cases to the correct support queue based on case category.
Drafting a personalized follow-up email to a customer after a support case is resolved.
explanation: El uso principal de Prompt Builder es generar contenido en lenguaje natural a partir de datos estructurados. Redactar correos personalizados de seguimiento es un ejemplo perfecto de esta capacidad.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is configuring a custom agent action and has confirmed the topic assignment is correct. However, the LLM is consistently selecting the wrong action during agent reasoning. Which element of the action's structure in Agent Script most directly influences the LLM's decision about when to invoke a specific action?
options: `target`
`label`
`description`
explanation: El motor de razonamiento del LLM utiliza principalmente el campo `description` para decidir qué acción invocar. Una descripción clara y específica es fundamental para evitar enrutamientos incorrectos.

question: A conversational AI specialist at GreenLeaf Insurance is presenting the value of Observability to the product team. The team wants to understand why monitoring intents and session metrics is essential when managing a deployed agent. What is the primary reason for reviewing these metrics?
options: To pinpoint the exact moment in a single session where the agent gave an incorrect answer to a user.
To measure how many sessions ended without a human handoff and calculate the cost savings per deflection.
To assess the agent's overall effectiveness by analyzing patterns such as misrouted intents, escalation frequency, and resolution success across all conversations.
explanation: El análisis de métricas agregadas permite identificar patrones sistémicos y evaluar la efectividad global del agente. No está pensado para depurar casos puntuales o basarse en métricas aisladas de ahorro.

question: Skyline Property Management is rolling out an Agentforce Service Agent on Email to handle tenant maintenance requests. The operations team has prepared an email layout and wants it consistently applied to every message the agent sends. What should the Agentforce Specialist recommend to properly connect the layout to the agent?
options: Configure a Flow-based Draft Email action and attach the email layout as a template parameter within the flow definition.
Design the email structure using a classic email template and assign it to the Service Agent through the channel settings.
Build a Lightning email template that defines the email structure and connect it to the Agentforce Service Agent.
explanation: El canal de Agentforce Service Agent por correo electrónico requiere específicamente usar una plantilla de correo Lightning. Esta plantilla incluye marcadores donde el agente insertará su respuesta dinámica.

question: At VaultSecure Bank, the agent handling loan modification requests must always run a credit eligibility check before presenting any repayment options. Auditors have flagged that in a number of sessions the credit check was skipped entirely. An Agentforce Specialist recommends inserting procedural instructions with `run @actions.check_credit_eligibility` followed by `run @actions.present_repayment_options`. What is the outcome of applying this configuration?
options: The credit eligibility check will execute as a strong recommendation to the LLM, though the model retains the ability to skip it if it determines the check is redundant based on prior conversation context.

The credit eligibility check will always run before repayment options are presented in every conversation, as procedural instructions enforce deterministic execution order at runtime independently of the LLM.
The credit eligibility check will run after the LLM validates the session, but applying this instruction will restrict the agent from using personalized language when communicating repayment options.
explanation: Las instrucciones de procedimiento (`run`) imponen una ejecución determinista e inalterable en tiempo de ejecución. Obligan al LLM a ejecutar procesos como verificaciones de crédito de forma garantizada.

question: WellPath Behavioral Health is configuring its Agentforce Testing Center to evaluate whether its patient support agent follows a proprietary "Compassionate Engagement Model" before suggesting any treatment resources. The quality team needs to verify both emotional sensitivity and strict adherence to the model's steps. Where should the Agentforce Specialist implement an LLM-as-judge evaluation to assess these criteria?
options: Adjust the scoring thresholds of the built-in Coherence evaluation so the LLM judge penalizes responses that lack emotional sensitivity or skip framework steps.
Activate the native Instruction Adherence evaluation and map each step of the Compassionate Engagement Model to the agent's existing topic instructions.
Build a custom evaluation with a purpose-written prompt that defines the Compassionate Engagement Model criteria for the LLM judge to score against.
explanation: Para evaluar criterios cualitativos y subjetivos, se requiere configurar una evaluación personalizada con el LLM como juez. Esto permite definir detalladamente los estándares propios de la empresa en el prompt evaluador.

question: AdventureNow, an outdoor travel platform, wants its Agentforce Service Agent to answer customer questions about real-time trail conditions, weather alerts, and park entry requirements using current internet data. What must the Agentforce Specialist configure to enable this capability correctly?
options: Build a dedicated Web Research subagent from scratch and configure it to replace the default General FAQ subagent, routing all factual queries through the new topic.
Connect a Data 360 vector search index to a web retriever and activate it within the agent settings before publishing the agent.
Enable the Answer Questions with Knowledge standard action on the General FAQ subagent and configure it to use web search as its grounding source.
explanation: La acción estándar 'Answer Questions with Knowledge' puede usar una biblioteca de datos configurada con búsqueda web. Esto permite fundamentar respuestas utilizando información extraída de internet en tiempo real.

question: ArcBridge Capital is expanding its Agentforce environment to integrate AI agents with a mix of internal risk assessment databases, third-party market data feeds, and local analyst tools. The Agentforce Specialist wants to avoid building one-off connectors for each system and recommends Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead. What is the core purpose of adopting MCP in this context?
options: To permanently embed market data and risk assessment records into the LLM's parameters so the agent can operate without making live data calls.
To enable the agent to autonomously delegate risk evaluation subtasks to third-party financial AI agents across different institutional boundaries.
To establish a standardized, secure channel through which AI models can connect to and retrieve context from diverse local and remote data sources without custom integration code for each one.
explanation: Model Context Protocol (MCP) es un estándar que permite conectar un modelo de IA a múltiples fuentes de datos de forma uniforme. Esto elimina la necesidad de programar integraciones uno a uno para cada sistema externo.

question: A compliance specialist at HarborTrust Mortgage previously recommended deleting outdated loan policy documents from Data 360 to prevent the agent from surfacing obsolete terms. Legal has since clarified that every historical policy version must remain accessible, as each version is still contractually binding for customers who signed under it. What should the Agentforce Specialist now recommend?
options: Create a dedicated data stream for each policy version and point the agent to the appropriate unstructured data model object matching the customer's contract date, keeping each version's vectors fully isolated.

Configure a custom retriever with a dynamic filter on the policy version metadata field, populated at runtime from the customer's Contract record in CRM, so retrieval is scoped to the correct version before similarity ranking.
Tag each document chunk with its policy version as a prepend field at indexing time, then rely on the LLM to identify and select the appropriate version when generating its response.
explanation: Configurar un 'retriever' personalizado con un filtro dinámico asegura que solo se busquen y devuelvan fragmentos de una versión específica del documento. Esto evita sobrecargar índices o depender del criterio del LLM.

question: BlueRidge Manufacturing wants to include live production order status in its AI prompt responses. The order data lives in an external MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and is surfaced in Salesforce via Salesforce Connect. What is the most appropriate data grounding technique to use in the prompt template?
options: Apex merge fields to write a custom method that retrieves the order data programmatically at prompt generation time.
External Services merge fields to invoke the MES API endpoint and inject the response into the prompt.
External Object Record merge fields to pull the live order status from the external MES system directly into the prompt template.
explanation: Se deben utilizar campos de combinación de registros (Record Merge Fields) para extraer información de External Objects expuestos vía Salesforce Connect. Así se integra el dato externo directamente al prompt de forma nativa.

question: Apex Voyages, a luxury cruise line operator, has deployed an agent to manage guest bookings, excursion reservations, and loyalty upgrades. The agent needs to respond naturally to guest inquiries but must always run a credit hold check before confirming any upgrade. The development team is evaluating instruction patterns. Which statement accurately describes hybrid reasoning in Agentforce Agent Script?
options: Hybrid reasoning depends on two separate language models running in parallel, with one dedicated to conversational tasks and the other to deterministic operations.
Hybrid reasoning mixes natural language instructions that the LLM interprets adaptively with prefixed commands that execute in an enforced, unchangeable order.
Hybrid reasoning requires storing all conversational logic in external CRM flows and all business rules in Apex triggers for proper separation.
explanation: El razonamiento híbrido en Agent Script combina instrucciones declarativas para la interacción natural con comandos de procedimiento deterministas. Todo esto se ejecuta dentro de un único modelo, sin necesidad de herramientas externas.

question: Northern Timber Co. is finalizing version 9 of a prompt template with significant updates from version 8. A pricing miscalculation is discovered in version 8 that requires an urgent hotfix in production. The finance team will deploy the fix as a new version. How can the specialist keep their work on version 9 safe while the hotfix is deployed?
options: Overwrite version 8 with the hotfix, then manually re-apply the version 9 changes on top of the corrected version 8.
Keep version 9 unchanged; the finance team should deploy the hotfix as version 10, preserving version 9 as is.
Pause work on version 9, apply the hotfix directly to version 9, and redeploy version 9 as the new production version.
explanation: Las versiones son independientes y coexisten sin sobreescribirse. Desplegar el hotfix como una versión nueva es la vía segura, dejando la versión 9 intacta.

question: Sunrise Bakery has detailed recipe documents where allergen warnings are often embedded inside larger ingredient sections. The agent must retrieve these allergen notes accurately, but the default chunking method splits them apart. Which chunking adjustment should the administrator make?
options: Decrease chunk size to individual words and use a phrase-matching algorithm at query time.
Increase chunk size so that entire ingredient sections, including embedded warnings, remain as whole chunks.
Switch to fixed-size character chunks with no overlap to ensure uniform chunk lengths.
explanation: El tamaño del chunk determina cuánto contexto se mantiene junto. Aumentar el tamaño ayuda a que secciones completas permanezcan en el mismo chunk, mejorando la recuperación.

question: Blue Harbor Marina is configuring a Data Library connected to Salesforce Knowledge. They need to select identifying fields to help the agent find relevant boat maintenance guides. The guides are long and detailed. What should they use as identifying fields?
options: The full guide text, as it contains all maintenance steps and safety warnings.
Short descriptive fields such as the guide title, a one-sentence summary, or keyword tags like "engine" or "hull."
Any rich text field that contains the guide's last inspection date or author name.
explanation: Los identifying fields deben ser metadatos concisos y buscables que ayuden a ubicar rápido el documento. El texto completo pertenece a los content fields, usados para fundamentar la respuesta.

question: Silver Maple Forestry built a custom retriever to ground AI responses on tree growth logs. They now need a "soil type" field from the search index to be included in the retriever's output. What is the recommended action?
options: Create a completely new custom retriever with the soil type field added, then delete the original retriever.
Edit the existing retriever's configuration to include the soil type field in the returned fields, save as a new version, and activate the new version.
Switch to the default retriever, which automatically includes all fields from every indexed log entry.
explanation: Los custom retrievers manejan versiones activables. Se recomienda editar la configuración existente, guardar como nueva versión y activarla para no romper referencias.

question: Calm Waters Counseling is troubleshooting an end-user report about a missing session in the Processed Sessions tab of Agentforce Observability. What should the specialist consider?
options: The session may be waiting in the Unprocessed Sessions queue because processing is asynchronous and can be delayed.
The agent must be re-registered with the observability service before any sessions will appear.
Sessions are only processed after a nightly batch run, so the specialist must wait until the next day.
explanation: Las sesiones procesadas pueden demorar en aparecer debido al procesamiento asíncrono. El sistema usa colas y puede haber retrasos en reflejarse.
